title: Senior Product Designer, dCX Design
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Team & Role**
This role is part of our Product Design team that uses their superpower of empathizing, understanding, and applying our users’ and customers’ needs, with the mission to created product experiences they love. Our designers come from a varied set of skills and background - design systems, visual, interaction, content, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has a very intentional seat at the table, so our team collaborates closely with both engineering and product management from the get-go.
  
  
Learn more about our team here https://www.linkedin.com/company/servicenow/life/userexperience/
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**

* You get to develop innovative design solutions and world-class product experiences that transform how people work around the world
* You drive user experiences from concept to delivery based on in-depth comprehension of user needs and design principles
* As part of a cross-functional team, you will have the opportunity to champion your design approach, reconcile feedback from various stakeholders, and provide your input to others in a collaborative, supportive, working environment. You will also have the chance to grow your leadership skills through coaching and mentoring other team members

**Qualifications**
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 5+ years of relevant design experience
* An inspiring portfolio demonstrating end-to-end, user-centered, design solutions based on human-centered design and research data
* Strong experience working with design tools to create comprehensive high-fidelity design solutions and specifications that enforce consistency, usability, and accessibility as part of a larger system or product
* A growth mindset, continually strengthening core skills through complex assignments and varied experience
* Ability to build trusting relationships through clear and open communication
* Experience participating in the complete product development lifecycle of web and/or software applications.
* Experience in user experience design or industry experience (corporate, software, web or agency)

Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Product Designer
description:
We're looking for a
**highly independent, product-minded designer**
who can take complete ownership of design at Pinegap, spanning Product Design, UI/UX, interaction design, and rapid prototyping.

This is not a role where you'll simply receive requirements and turn them into Figma screens. We want someone who can understand complex problems, challenge assumptions, think from first principles, and independently translate ideas into exceptional product experiences. You'll work closely with the founders, product, and engineering teams, with significant ownership over how our products look, feel, and function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Design Ownership:**
  Independently own product design across our web platform, AI agents, research dashboards, and internal tools, from ideation to final implementation.
* **UI/UX & Product Thinking:**
  Translate complex financial research workflows into intuitive, elegant, and scalable user experiences.
* **AI-Native Product Design:**
  Design interfaces for AI-powered products, including conversational experiences, agentic workflows, and human-AI interactions.
* **Rapid Prototyping:**
  Use AI-powered tools to rapidly convert ideas into interactive, functional prototypes and validate concepts before engineering implementation.
* **Design Systems:**
  Build and maintain consistent design systems, reusable components, and interaction patterns.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Work directly with founders, engineers, and product stakeholders to shape product direction and execute design initiatives.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Proactively identify UX gaps, recommend improvements, and drive initiatives without waiting for detailed instructions.

**What We're Looking For**

**Product Design Experience**

* Proven experience designing and shipping complex web-based products, preferably in AI, B2B SaaS, fintech, or enterprise software.
* Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, and design systems.
* Experience working on AI-native products, particularly LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or conversational interfaces.
* Ability to simplify complex workflows and large amounts of information into clean, intuitive interfaces.

**Tools & Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Figma, including advanced prototyping, components, and design systems.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools such as Claude, Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable, or similar platforms.
* Ability to build interactive or functional prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools.
* Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, React, or Tailwind is a strong advantage.
* Comfortable collaborating with engineering teams and understanding technical constraints.

**Mindset & Ownership**

* **High Accountability:**
  Takes full responsibility for deliverables, timelines, and design quality.
* **Independent Execution:**
  Comfortable operating with minimal supervision and ambiguous requirements.
* **Critical Thinking:**
  Challenges assumptions, asks the right questions, and focuses on solving underlying user problems.
* **Bias for Action:**
  Moves quickly from problem identification to prototypes, testing, and implementation.
* **Product-First Approach:**
  Thinks beyond aesthetics and understands how design impacts usability, adoption, and business outcomes.
* **Proactive Communication:**
  Can independently collaborate with distributed teams and communicate design decisions effectively.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience working in early-stage startups or high-ownership product teams.
* Prior experience building AI-powered or data-intensive B2B SaaS products.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership, problem-solving, and shipped products.
* Experience working directly with founders and engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to accelerate design and prototype development.

**Why Join Pinegap?**

* **Own the Design Function:**
  Take significant ownership of product design and influence the direction of our platform.
* **Build at the AI Frontier:**
  Work on real-world applications of LLMs and AI agents for institutional investment research.
* **Work with Global Customers:**
  Design products used by sophisticated investment professionals and funds worldwide.
* **High-Impact Role:**
  Work directly with founders and engineering teams, with minimal bureaucracy and fast decision-making.
* **Build, Experiment, Ship:**
  Join an environment where ideas can quickly become working products.

**Important Requirements**

* This is a
  **full-time, work-from-office role in Bengaluru**
  .
* Candidates must be comfortable with working hours that provide meaningful overlap with US Eastern Time.
* We are specifically looking for someone who can work independently with limited guidance and take end-to-end responsibility for design.
* A portfolio showcasing product design, problem-solving, and preferably AI-powered prototypes is required.

**How to Apply**

**If you're a product designer who loves solving complex problems, experimenting with AI tools, and building products from scratch, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Please share your CV, portfolio, and examples of AI-powered prototypes or products you've worked on**
at hiring@pinegap.us

B.Tech/BE or M.Tech/ME or PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  
  
**Job Summary:**
As a UI/UX Consultant within the S&C GN Customer Service Analytics & Contact Center AI practice, you will be responsible for designing, prototyping, and implementing intuitive, high-performance user interfaces that power enterprise Contact Center AI platform implementations. Your typical day will involve translating complex business requirements into user-centered design solutions using Figma or Adobe XD, building production-ready frontend components using React/Next.js, integrating real-time WebRTC communication features, collaborating with backend and CCaaS integration teams, and advising clients on design systems, accessibility standards, and UX strategy across all phases of delivery.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design and deliver end-to-end UX solutions — from user research, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma/Adobe XD/Sketch to production-ready frontend implementations — for Contact Center AI dashboards, agent workspaces, and supervisor monitoring interfaces.
* Build scalable, reusable frontend components and design systems using React/Angular/Vue/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and component libraries (Material UI, Tailwind, Storybook) that are consumed across multiple product teams and client engagements.
* Design and implement real-time communication UX for video/audio/data channels using WebRTC — covering peer-to-peer media streams, signaling server integration (WebSocket/SIP), STUN/TURN/ICE configuration, and SFU/MCU architectures (e.g., Janus, LiveKit) — with robust connection state management and graceful degradation patterns.
* Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs and implement authentication/authorization flows (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) within frontend applications, ensuring secure, token-refresh-aware, and optimistic-update-driven user experiences.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility and WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance across all deliverables; conduct and act on usability testing, A/B testing, and user research sessions to continuously improve experience quality.
* Optimize frontend performance through code splitting, lazy loading, virtual scrolling, SSR/SSG strategies, and Core Web Vitals monitoring; advise clients on responsive, mobile-first design principles and progressive enhancement.
* Collaborate with CI/CD pipeline teams to integrate frontend build, lint, test (Jest, Playwright/Cypress), visual regression (Chromatic), and deployment stages into GitHub Actions/GitLab CI workflows; support cloud deployments on AWS/GCP/Azure (S3, CloudFront, Vercel).
* Lead client-facing UX discovery workshops and design reviews; advise on design system governance, component library strategy, and UX toolchain selection prior to and during engagement onboarding.
* Design conversational UI patterns and integrate real-time AI features — including streaming AI responses, transcription overlays, AI confidence indicators, and RAG-powered search UX — into contact center communication platforms.
* Mentor analysts and junior designers/developers; conduct design and code reviews across frontend workstreams; present UX and architecture decisions to senior client stakeholders and maintain documentation for knowledge transfer.

**Professional & Technical Skills:**
**Must To Have Skills:**

* UI/UX design and prototyping using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch — covering wireframing, interactive prototyping, design tokens, and design system governance
* Frontend development using React/Angular/Vue/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and component libraries (Material UI, Tailwind CSS, Storybook)
* Deep WebRTC expertise — peer-to-peer media streams, signaling servers (WebSocket/SIP), STUN/TURN/ICE configuration, SFU/MCU architectures (e.g., Janus, LiveKit), and real-time communication UX patterns for video/audio/data channels
* REST/GraphQL API integration with authentication/authorization implementation (OAuth2, JWT, SSO, MFA, RBAC) within single-page and server-rendered applications
* Cross-browser compatibility and accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1) — including semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, and automated auditing (axe-core, Lighthouse)
* Performance optimization — code splitting, lazy loading, virtual scrolling, SSR/SSG/ISR, bundle analysis, CDN strategy, and Core Web Vitals improvement
* Responsive and mobile-first design; user research, usability testing, and A/B testing methodologies
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), Git branching strategies, and cloud deployment for frontend applications (AWS S3/CloudFront, GCP, Azure, Vercel/Netlify)

**Additional Information:**

* The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in Computer Science or a related field, along with a proven track record of delivering design systems and production-grade frontend applications within enterprise cloud and Contact Center AI environments.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary:**

Daignostix builds clinical AI and healthcare platforms used in high-volume, time-sensitive workflows, including worklists, dashboards, reporting, scheduling, monitoring and AI decision support, for professional users who need to understand complex information quickly and act with confidence.

As UI/UX Designer, you will own the user experience for assigned product areas end to end, from workflow observation and problem framing through design, validation, implementation and post-release refinement. This is not a PRD-to-Figma role: you are expected to challenge weak workflows and influence product direction with evidence.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

● End-to-end product ownership. Own assigned product areas from discovery to release: frame the problem, map workflows, prototype and validate alternatives, deliver implementation-ready designs and refine after launch.

● User research and validation. Conduct contextual inquiry, clinical shadowing, task analysis and usability testing with radiologists, operations teams and administrators, and turn findings into product decisions.

● Workflow and interaction design. Design fast, low-error workflows for expert users across dense tables, queues, alerts, statuses, permissions, forms and bulk actions, including loading, empty, error and recovery states.

● Visual craft and data visualisation. Deliver interfaces with strong hierarchy, typography and consistency, and design dashboards, worklists and monitoring views that make dense clinical and operational data easy to act on.

● Design system. Own and evolve the Figma design system (tokens, components, variants, patterns and documentation), keeping it implementable and consistent with frontend engineering.

● Engineering collaboration. Partner with product managers and React/frontend engineers from solution design through release. Provide precise specifications and review the built product until it meets the intended experience.

● Accessibility and measurement. Design to WCAG 2.2 AA, and define and track usability measures such as task completion, time on task, error rate and adoption.

**Requirements:**

**Must-have:**

● Education. Bachelor's or Master's in Interaction, Communication or Product Design, HCI or a related discipline from a highly selective institution (e.g., NID Ahmedabad, IDC School of Design - IIT Bombay, IIT design departments, or a comparable global programme). Exceptional engineering graduates are considered only with an elite product-design portfolio.

● Experience. 5-7 years of hands-on product design in complex B2B SaaS, enterprise, healthcare/medtech or similarly demanding products that were actually shipped and used.

● Portfolio (mandatory). 3-5 case studies from shipped, complex products showing the problem, users, evidence, IA and interaction decisions, alternatives, iterations, engineering collaboration and outcome. Portfolios dominated by visual concepts or redesign exercises will not qualify.

● Figma mastery. Auto Layout, components, variants, variables/tokens, libraries, prototyping and developer handoff, with the ability to build and maintain a design system.

● UX and visual depth. Strong information architecture, interaction design, data-dense interfaces, user research, accessibility, typography, layout and colour.

● Frontend awareness. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS, responsive behaviour and component-based frontends. Coding expertise is not required.

**Good-to-have:**

● Healthcare and AI. Experience in healthcare, radiology, clinical workflow or AI-assisted products, including how to represent confidence, uncertainty and AI findings responsibly.

● Service design. Journey mapping, service blueprints and UX writing.

● Design leadership. Raising design quality through critique, reviews and mentoring as a senior individual contributor.

**Key Skills:**

Figma | Design Systems | Components / Variants / Tokens | Product Discovery | User Research / Clinical Shadowing | Task Analysis | Journey Mapping / Service Blueprints | Information Architecture | Interaction Design | Prototyping / Usability Testing | Data-Dense Workflows / Dashboards | Data Visualisation | Responsive Design | WCAG 2.2 AA | UX Writing | Design QA | HTML / CSS / React Awareness

**Why Join Daignostix:**

● UX that changes real work. Your interfaces will support faster, safer clinical and operational decisions under time pressure.

● Own the full experience. Work from workflow observation through design system, implementation and production feedback.

● Direct access to experts. Work closely with radiologists, operations, AI and frontend engineers, and company leadership.

title: Product Designer
description:

Such products come out of working in close collaboration with business, product, technology teams, and fellow designers. You would also be presenting design propositions and solutions to stakeholders using wireframes, mock-ups, or high-fidelity prototypes. Feedback is breakfast of champions, and we'd ensure you'd get as much as you need to iterate and improve to reach our mutual goal of building a world-class product.

* Ideate and implement solutions that overlap customer needs, design and technology.
* Gather requirements from stakeholders, derive problem statements and plan design engagements. Also, proactively launch efforts to improve different aspects of the product.
* Be the owner & decision-maker of design for one or more major features in the consumer app.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and content strategists to oversee the user experience of a product from conception until its launch.
* Ensuring design quality, consistency, and coherence within the product.
* Design flows and experiences that are incredibly simple and elegant. Give and solicit feedback from other designers to continually raise our bar for quality.
* Comfortably build out experiences on design tools as well as AI/vibe-coding interfaces.
* Conceptualise original ideas that bring simplicity and user-friendliness to complex design roadblocks.
* Collaborate and conduct user research and evaluate user feedback on designs and do iterations according to feedback.
* Research, learn and implement design guidelines, best practices and design standards. Experiment and validate design ideas and opinions.

**What you'll need**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in design.
* 1-3 years of experience designing in consumer-focused product companies.
* Expertise in design tools like Figma, Sketch, Principle etc.
* Experience designing using AI/vibe-coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Google Stitch, Figma Make, Lovable etc. We don’t need you to know/use all of them, but we’d like you to be proficient in at least one of them.
* Exceptional analytical skills, with an ability to quickly translate both qualitative and quantitative data-driven insights into actions.
* Excellent visual design skills, experience in illustration & motion design is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills & attention to detail.

slice

A new bank for a new India

slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, and slice business are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.

title: Director of Product Experience & Design - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

**The role**
  

Every organization now runs on identities, devices and, increasingly, AI agents. Someone has to decide who and what gets access to what, and keep it secure. At JumpCloud, that is often a small IT team responsible for an entire workforce across Mac, Windows, Linux and mobile, using one platform in place of several. For them, the experience is the product. When it is clear, a lean team runs what once took a stack of tools and a much larger staff. When it is not, people get locked out and risks go unseen.

  

That experience will change more in the next two years than in the last ten. Admins will ask an assistant instead of opening a console. AI agents will need identities, permissions and oversight of their own. Some of our most important experiences will have no screen at all.

  

We are looking for the
**design leader**
who will define what comes next. You will set the experience vision for the platform, decide where design invests across the interface, AI and headless experiences, and build a team known for its craft and its judgment. You will sit with Product and Engineering leadership as an equal partner, and your measure will be simple: how much easier, safer and faster our customers' work becomes.

**What we're looking for:**
  

  
* **Ownership of outcomes.**
  You hold design to outcomes for customers and the business. You write down your plans, make decisions with Product and Engineering partners, and follow the work through to adoption.
  
* **A clear view of where experience is going.**
  Users increasingly work through AI assistants, agents and APIs as well as through our interface. You can turn that shift into priorities: what to improve in the UI, what to make AI-assisted, and what to make headless, backed by data.
  
* **Craft and a high bar.**
  You model the quality bar yourself, give specific and candid feedback, and build the standards and systems that keep quality consistent across a broad product.
  
* **Hands-on with AI.**
  In the last two to three years you have changed how a design team works with AI, in practice, from prototyping in code to research synthesis. You can show what worked and what did not.
  
* **A leader who builds teams.**
  You grow designers and managers across locations, hire well, and build shared ownership with Product and Engineering. You run the critiques and skillshares that sharpen the craft, add strength in end-to-end experience design, and build a team designers want to join.
  
  

  
**What you'll own:**
  

  
* **Experience vision:**
  a multi-year vision for the platform and the priorities that follow from it, across the admin console, the end-user experience, and AI-assisted and agent-driven workflows, in partnership with Product owners.
  
* **Core workflows:**
  with Product partners, our most important end-to-end workflows, held to one bar: consistent, intuitive, self-service, and reliable on both the success and failure paths.
  
* **Trust and security in every flow:**
  permissions, policies, sign-in, recovery and alerts, designed so admins act with confidence and employees stay secure without friction.
  
* **Adoption and onboarding:**
  how customers discover, learn and adopt what we build, through in-product guidance, announcements and onboarding, measured by adoption of key workflows.
  
* **Measuring experience:**
  a clear measure of user satisfaction that brings together NPS, product feedback, support and research, and the actions the team takes on it.
  
* **Research practice:**
  discovery, usability testing and post-launch measurement that shape decisions before they are made and show what changed after.
  
* **Quality and craft:**
  design reviews that hold a clear bar, accessibility standards, and the strategy and governance of our design system, including how it carries through from Figma to code.
  
* **Team and capacity:**
  how the team is organized, where its time goes, and the design operations (documentation, standards and workflows) that help a distributed team move fast, so design investment follows company priorities.
  
* **AI-enabled design practice:**
  how the whole team uses AI, from discovery and synthesis to prototyping in code, made practical and repeatable.
  
  

  
**What you bring:**
  

  
* 10+ years in product design, including 4+ years leading design managers and multi-disciplinary teams in B2B SaaS.
  
* A track record of experience improvements with measurable results, such as adoption, task success, support volume or NPS.
  
* Experience shaping AI-powered or agent-driven product experiences, with a point of view on where they are heading.
  
* Experience designing complex, technical or security-critical products. Identity, security, device management, IT or developer tools experience is a strong plus.
  
* Hands-on building and prototyping in code with AI tools such as Claude or Cursor, plus advanced Figma fluency: components, variables, tokens and design systems at scale.
  
* Clear, confident communication with senior leaders, including when the answer is no.
  
  

  
**Good to have:**

title: Senior UX Designer, Marketplace & CX
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
An eBay subsidiary, TCGplayer is on a quest to be the most trusted trading card game (TCG) platform — connecting and empowering the hobby community. Trading card games are a $25B global market that creates community connection through in-person games (Pokémon; Magic: The Gathering; Yu-Gi-Oh!; etc.). Founded by TCG enthusiasts, we operate a global marketplace, and create tools, technologies and solutions that help individuals and small businesses profitably sell TCGs at scale.
  
  
As a Senior User Experience Designer, you will apply your domain expertise and knowledge of UX best-practices to drive high-impact product improvements across our TCGplayer ecosystem including our mobile and desktop marketplace, seller tools and customer service representative workflows. You will join us as we explore emerging design-to-code workflows and AI-augmented design tools, helping to shape how we work. In this design role, you will partner with cross-functional peers to design and deliver user-centered solutions for both buyers and sellers.
  
  
Our User Experience Design team prides itself on creating a culture that fosters camaraderie, embraces diversity, and exudes passion. We value curiosity, craft, and a desire to directly interact with the real world. You don’t have to be a hobbyist or gamer to love working in TCGplayer’s UX Design organization, but you should be comfortable with ambiguity and eager to amplify our steadfast commitment to making hobbies and games accessible, fun, and rewarding for everyone. If you’re equal parts “empathy” and “ambition,” this is an opportunity to take risks and stretch yourself, surrounded by teammates who will support you along the way.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Create UX deliverables throughout the design process, evolving designs from early concepts, wireframes, and prototypes to final specifications
* Deliver high-value features across multiple projects, ensuring design solutions support user needs, align with business goals, and positively impact key performance metrics
* Apply advanced knowledge of Figma to create, iterate, and hand off design assets while working within an established design system
* Demonstrate fluency with modern AI tools and methods, applying them thoughtfully across the design process and broader workflow to accelerate exploration, iteration, collaboration, and delivery
* Collaborate with product and engineering teammates to deliver high-quality solutions that drive value, inform product strategy, and support data-driven decision-making
* Participate in user testing, workshops, and research efforts to gather insights and validate design decisions
* Obtain leadership approval and team alignment through compelling storytelling that clearly communicates your ideas and design rationale

**What You Will Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in a dedicated User Experience Design role, with a bachelor’s degree in Design, Human–Computer Interaction (HCI), or equivalent practical experience
* Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end, user-centered design solutions with measurable impact across both mobile applications and desktop web experiences
* Demonstrated experience designing intuitive mobile experiences for iOS and/or Android, including understanding of Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design
* Demonstrated experience designing desktop web experiences, including responsive layouts, complex interactions, information-dense interfaces, and multi-step workflows
* Experience designing for both consumer-facing and enterprise products is strongly preferred, with an understanding of how user needs, behaviors, and design approaches differ across these contexts
* Demonstrated understanding of accessible and inclusive design principles, including WCAG guidelines and platform-specific accessibility standards
* Advanced proficiency in Figma and experience creating, iterating, documenting, and handing off design assets within an established design language system
* Fluency with modern AI tools and methods, demonstrated through active, thoughtful application of AI across the design workflow
* Comfort working in technical environments and alongside engineering tools, emerging technologies, and AI-augmented product-development workflows
* Extensive experience using research, usability testing, and quantitative and qualitative data to inform design decisions across mobile and desktop experiences
* Extensive experience working in an agile, multidisciplinary environment alongside designers, product managers, software engineers, researchers, and stakeholders
* Proven ability to lead all aspects of a design project within a software-development environment, from strategy and discovery through execution, launch, measurement, and ongoing iteration
* Excellent interpersonal, collaboration, presentation, and communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with the gaming, hobby, or collectibles community — particularly trading card games
* Experience designing products for a North American markets
* Experience designing internal tools such as customer support interfaces

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
  
  
We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

The role turns business priorities (launches, exclusives, sale events, competitive responses) into fast, on-brand creatives that drive traffic, click-through and conversion, while staying within the global PUMA design language.

* Design homepage, category and campaign banners, landing pages and PDP support assets for Puma.com and the Puma app, in line with global guidelines and localised for India.
* Deliver creatives at speed for sale events, product launches and competitive-response moments (e.g. limited-window sale plays and hero product drops) with quick turnarounds, without compromising quality.

title: Creative Designer
description:
**Your impact begins here**
As Creative Designer, you will turn ideas, data and complex messages into clear, engaging visuals that help Global Corporate Affairs connect with leaders, colleagues and stakeholders around the world. You will shape leadership presentations, campaigns, events, newsletters and SharePoint sites, keeping every output consistent with the Novo brand and accessible to its audience. Your work helps people understand what matters, and act on it, faster.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* A degree in creative and design, or a graduate or post-graduate degree from a recognised university with documented experience in creative and design.
* At least 6–7 years of creative and design experience in a global organisation or an agency, with a proven ability to take projects from brief to finished product.
* Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, InDesign).
* Proficiency in UI design and prototyping tools such as Sketch, InVision and Lunacy.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office and SharePoint, and good knowledge of content management and digital asset management systems.
* Experience working with AI platforms such as Copilot and ChatGPT.
* Strong experience working with internal stakeholders and creative agencies.
* Knowledge and understanding of data privacy and GDPR.
* Fluent English, spoken and written, and the ability to listen well, communicate clearly and manage feedback.
* A creative, proactive, detail-oriented and service-minded approach, and the flexibility to work both independently and as part of a team.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with Figma.
* Experience working with visual identity in a corporate brand context.
* Experience in the pharma or healthcare industry.

**What You’ll Do**
You will be the creative hand behind many of Global Corporate Affairs’ most visible materials, balancing planned initiatives with ad hoc requests while keeping quality high.
  
  

* Interpret stakeholder briefs, objectives and content, and turn them into practical, purpose-driven designs delivered on time, even when priorities shift.
* Design and elevate leadership presentations and communication materials for important meetings and business initiatives.
* Create presentations, newsletters (using Microsoft Word and Dot Digital), icons, templates, motion graphics and video support for social media, suited to different audiences, platforms and formats.
* Convert dense information and data into clear, accessible visual stories, and enhance the design of SharePoint sites and pages to improve user experience.
* Build intuitive templates, master designs and adaptable visual frameworks that help teams create consistent, brand-aligned materials.
* Keep stakeholders informed on scope, progress, timelines and dependencies, and look for ways to streamline workflows, including responsible use of AI-enabled tools.
* Act as a sparring partner for design colleagues, stakeholders and agencies, and run training and knowledge-sharing sessions on creative and design best practice.

**Who You’ll Work With**
You will join Global Corporate Affairs, part of People, Organisation & Corporate Affairs, where colleagues help create an engaging, inclusive workplace and attract and develop the talent needed to support Novo’s purpose.
  
  
Your closest partners will be GCA stakeholders and senior leaders, who rely on you for clear, polished materials, alongside internal teams, creative and design colleagues and external agencies. You will work with them to clarify requirements, agree on creative direction and bring feedback into the final result. The scope of the role is global, so the work you deliver will be seen across Novo.
  
  
**What You Can Expect Here**
You will be trusted to take ownership of your work and make your voice heard on creative direction. The role gives you room to grow your skills, from motion graphics and UI design to the responsible use of AI-enabled tools, and to share what you know through training and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  
  
You will be supported to perform at your best, in a team where clarity, collaboration and pace help good ideas reach the people who need them.
  
  
**Start now**
Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn complex messages into design that moves people to act, apply for the Creative Designer role by 8 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
  
  
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Our technology initiatives serve micro-enterprises—small retail shop owners, local vendors, and home-based producers. These users operate on thin margins, in patchy network conditions, often with limited digital literacy, and almost exclusively in regional languages. Very little off-the-shelf software fits their unique context and operational realities.

We are looking for an individual to own that technology stack end-to-end:

* **Field Data Collection:**
  Supporting our frontline community partner network.
* **User Delivery:**
  WhatsApp-first interfaces and workflows built directly for micro-business owners.
* **Localization:**
  Voice-enabled and vernacular user interfaces.
* **Data Architecture:**
  The underlying data layer driving core impact measurement and analytics.
* **Production AI:**
  Deploying and scaling AI systems into active production workflows.

This is a hands-on technology role. You will work on setting the product and engineering roadmap alongside program leadership, help decide what to build, estimate technical scope, and deliver high-quality outcomes.

**What you'll own**

* Design and build web and mobile applications that hold up in low-bandwidth and intermittently connected areas — offline-first, low-data, low-end Android
* Build voice-first and vernacular interfaces for users with low digital literacy

*Team and partners*

* Manage external technology partners, vendors, and other engineering collaborations
* Set engineering practice — review, testing, documentation, incident response — proportionate to a small team rather than ceremony for its own sake

Own privacy and consent design for data, including obligations under India's DPDP Act and the data commitments we make in grant agreements

**Skills and experience**

*Essential*

* 4 - 7 years building software, with strong programming fundamentals and real problem-solving depth — able to go deep in at least one language and pick up others quickly
* Solid database work: schema design, query design and performance, and modelling for
* Fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to ship quality code at high velocity
* Good grasp of web application design — APIs, authentication, state, caching, failure modes
* Clear written and spoken communication, and the ability to explain a technical tradeoffs

*Nice to have*

* Built for low-bandwidth, rural, or offline-first contexts in India
* Production experience with AI-native applications — systems real users depend on
* WhatsApp Business API or comparable messaging platforms at scale
* Speech technology (ASR/TTS) or Indic-language NLP
* Data engineering and analytics pipeline ownership
* Cloud infrastructure ownership on AWS or GCP, infrastructure-as-code, and cost management

*Mindsets we're looking for*

* A genuine pull towards social impact — one that shows up in the tradeoffs you make, not only in your interest in the sector
* Comfort with ambiguous and shifting requirements, and a habit of helping set the requirements rather than waiting to receive them
* Appetite for field immersion. You will spend time in markets with Saathis and Vyapaaris. This is not optional color — it is how you will know what to build

**Experience in Cloud and DevOps and languages required in website and platforms/products development.**

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Kirana Club is India's largest digital community of kirana owners. 45 lakh+ store owners use our app for news, mandi rates and peer advice, and order products to stock up their shops.

Our users run small shops in Tier 2, 3 and 4 towns and villages. Most read Hindi before English.

**About the role:**

You'll own every visual we use to bring new retailers to Kirana Club: Meta and Google ads, static and video, and the screens they land on. Paid acquisition runs on a ₹1Cr+ monthly budget, so your creatives decide who we reach and what each new retailer costs us.

Our user is a shop owner in a small town, scrolling between customers on a budget phone. Metro D2C playbooks (minimal layouts, English punchlines, lifestyle imagery) often don't land with them. We need someone who will find out what does: which number to make biggest, which product to show, which font and colour stop the scroll, and in which language.

This is a performance role first. Your work is judged on click-through, cost per retailer and first orders, not on likes. You'll run many small experiments every week, kill what doesn't work and scale what does.

अगर आप जानना चाहते हैं कि दुकानदार की नज़र पहले "थोक रेट" पर रुकती है या "MRP से 30% कम" पर, और इसे test करके साबित करना चाहते हैं, तो यह role आपके लिए है।

**What you'll do:**

* **Own performance creatives end to end:**

  Concept, design and ship static ads for Meta and Google, from the brief to the ad going live to the result coming back.
* **Decide what the ad says visually:**

  What goes first, what gets the most space (price, margin, product, offer), and which fonts, colours and layouts get the message across in under 2 seconds.
* **Run the creative testing engine:**

  Plan weekly tests with the performance marketing team across hooks, layouts, colours and formats. See which ads won on click-through, cost per retailer and first orders, and use what you learn to plan the next round of tests.
* **Design for Bharat, Hindi first:**

  Make creatives in Devanagari Hindi, and adapt them for state-level campaigns as we expand region by region.
* **Build a system, not one-offs:**

  Create templates and a visual playbook so a winning idea becomes dozens of variants in a day, and new brands and offers go live fast.
* **Work AI-first:**

  Use AI image tools like ChatGPT Images and Gemini, to explore ideas and produce variants at speed. Keep the judgment on what goes live.

**What we are looking for:**

* **2–5 years designing performance creatives:**

  Paid social, app-install or commerce ads, in-house at a consumer tech company or at a performance agency.
* **A portfolio of ads that actually ran:**

  For each, show the goal, what you tested, what won and what you learned.
* **Strong visual fundamentals:**

  Hierarchy, typography, colour and layout. You can explain why one version should beat another before the test runs.
* **An experiment mindset:**

  You'd rather ship ten rough variants and learn than polish one for a week.
* **AI-native:**

  You use ChatGPT Image, Gemini or similar tools every day, and can show how they make your work faster and better. [Must]
* **High ownership:**

  You push back on weak briefs, drive work without a perfect one, and stay with it after launch.
* **Based in Bengaluru,**

  ready to work from office.

**You'll thrive here if**

you start every design from the user. You're curious about how a kirana owner thinks, shops and reads a screen, and you're always trying a new layout, colour or format to see if it works better than the last one.

**Bonus Point:**

* **You've designed for Tier 2, 3 and 4 India:**

  Users who are new to the internet, price-sensitive and on budget phones, at a Bharat-first marketplace, fintech, or similar companies.
* **Strong Hindi:**

  You read and write it well, know how Devanagari behaves in an ad (matras, line height, weights), and can tell when a line sounds like a shopkeeper and when it sounds like a translation.
* **You know retail or FMCG:**

  Margin, scheme, MRP and bulk rate mean something to you, and to the people you design for.

**WhyJoin Us:**

* **Your work is the first impression:**

  For lakhs of shop owners, your ad is the first thing they ever see of Kirana Club.
* **Fast, real feedback:**

  A large monthly budget means your ideas get tested on large scale and you see results within days.
* **An audience few designers have cracked:**

  You'll define what great performance design looks like for Bharat's kirana owners.
* **Small team, large scope:**

  No layers between you, the performance team and the people who decide what we build next.

title: Web Designer
description:
As a Web Designer at Skydo, you’ll bring our visual identity to life through engaging web experiences and high-quality landing pages. Working closely with Growth and Product, you’ll create reusable design components and take ideas from concept to launch.

**What you will do:**

* Make the new look feel at home on the web. Carry our visual language across every page, so it all feels like one Skydo.
* Launch pages that do their job. Work with Growth on what each page needs to achieve, design it, ship it, and learn from the numbers.
* Add care to key product moments. Some moments in the product deserve more than a default. You'll make them feel special.
* Build the kit. Components and templates, so the next page takes a day, not a week.
* Take it live. With code or AI tools, you won't wait in a queue to see your work out in the world.

**You’re a good fit if you have:**

* 2-4 years of experience as a Web Designer
* You have a great eye for type, spacing, colour and composition, and can explain why something works.
* You ship. You've put work live, not just mocked it up.
* You're quick, but careful. Moving fast doesn't mean letting details slip.
* You own it. Rough brief in, polished launch out, and you check how it's doing after.
* You're curious. You notice great websites, try new tools early, and love taking things apart to see how they work.
* You care about words. A good headline is part of good design.

**How we Design:**

* Trust lives in the details. People trust us with their money. A misaligned number or a vague label chips away at that, so we sweat the small stuff.
* Simple, for busy people. Our customers have businesses to run. We keep things clear and calm so they can get on with it.
* Do it right once, then move fast. We're a startup, so speed matters. We take the time to get it right, turn it into a system, then build quickly on top.
* Use whatever helps. Figma, Framer, code, AI. We care about great work, not the tool.

**The mindset we’re seeking:**

* Real ownership from day one, with work that reaches 40,000+ businesses.
* A fresh canvas. A brand-new visual language and plenty of room to shape it.
* A team that cares about craft, with honest feedback and regular critiques.
* Room to play with motion, code and AI.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Who We Are**

UONEX is an AI-first platform that helps people find products in real stores near them, instantly. Whether it's a linen shirt or a full wedding look, UONEX connects shoppers with the shops around them that actually have what they want. On the other side, we work with brands, retail stores, and malls to help them get discovered by the customers walking past their doors, understand the demand signals & shopping behavior of shoppers. We're building the bridge between online search and offline shopping, and we're doing it physical-first.

**The Role**

We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. You'll design for both sides of UONEX: shoppers discovering what's good in their city (B2C), and the brands, stores, and malls we partner with (B2B).

Your day-to-day will be social media visuals, but the role goes beyond that. You'll also design landing pages and support the team with website and app screens as needed. You don't need to be a product designer, but you should be comfortable working in Figma and eager to grow across formats. What we need from you is a strong visual sense, attention to detail, and the ability to turn ideas into designs that look good and communicate clearly.

**Responsibilities**

* Design social media creatives for Instagram, LinkedIn, and X, including static posts, carousels, and stories.
* Create ad creatives for paid campaigns across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn, for both shopper-facing (B2C) and partner-facing (B2B) audiences.
* Design landing pages for campaigns, launches, and partner acquisition.
* Support the product and marketing teams with website and app screens when required.
* Work closely with the content team to bring copy to life visually.
* Adapt visual style between a vibrant, scroll-stopping consumer look and a clean, credible B2B look.
* Maintain consistency with UONEX's brand identity across every touchpoint, and help build and evolve our design system.
* Turn around quick iterations based on feedback and campaign performance.

**What You Are Expected To Bring**

* Proficiency in at least one of Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator
* Working knowledge of Figma (mandatory), including frames, components, and auto layout.
* Ability to design for different audiences, from everyday shoppers to business decision-makers.
* Basic understanding of how designs translate to web and mobile screens.
* Openness to feedback and eagerness to learn new formats quickly.
* Reliability with deadlines and proactive communication.

**Why Work With Us?**

* Be one of the first members of a marketing team being built from scratch.
* Work across social, ads, landing pages, and product screens, so you grow into a well-rounded designer.
* Design for both B2B and B2C audiences at a fast-moving, AI-first startup.
* Help shape the visual identity of a new product category from the ground up.
* A collaborative team that values ownership, fresh ideas, and great design.

title: Multimedia Intern
description:
**About the Role**

As a Multimedia Intern , you will work closely with the Marketing team to produce the design and video content that powers our marketing, within a fast-growing fintech and wealth management environment.

This is a hands-on production role. You will design marketing collaterals, edit and produce video content including AI-generated video, and work directly with channel owners across the team to turn briefs into finished assets. Given the range of what we produce - content and social channels, paid advertising, webinars and events, and product communication - you will build a broad portfolio across formats in a short space of time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design marketing collaterals, including one-pagers, presentations and decks, social media creatives, paid advertising creatives, and webinar and event collateral.
* Edit and produce video content, including product videos, AI-generated videos and short-form video for social and paid channels.
* Work directly with channel owners across the Marketing team to understand briefs and deliver the design and video assets each channel requires.
* Produce creative variations and adapt assets to the specifications of different platforms, formats and placements.
* Maintain and organise brand assets, templates and project files so that recurring collateral can be produced quickly and consistently.
* Ensure all output is consistent with brand guidelines across visual identity, typography and tone.
* Manage multiple briefs and deadlines at the same time, keeping stakeholders updated on timelines and delivery.
* Support other creative and marketing initiatives as required by the Marketing team.

**What You'll Work On**

* Marketing collateral across our active channels - creatives, decks, one-pagers and campaign assets used in live marketing.
* Paid advertising creatives, including variations built and iterated on for performance campaigns.
* Webinar and event collateral, from pre-event promotion through to post-event content.
* AI-generated video content, using AI video and audio tools as part of day-to-day production.
* Product videos that explain our platform, products and features to investors and partners.
* Short-form video and motion graphics for social and content channels.
* Brand and template systems that make recurring production faster and more consistent.

**Why should you join us?**

* Creative work that ships: Everything you produce goes into live marketing across our active channels, paid campaigns and events, rather than into internal-only material.
* Hands-on with AI video and design tools: Build practical, current experience with AI video generation and AI-assisted design as a core part of the role rather than a side experiment.
* Breadth of formats: Move between static design, motion, product video and campaign creative, and develop a portfolio that is not limited to a single format.
* Exposure to global markets: Work in a business operating across multiple markets including Singapore, Hong Kong, India and the UAE, and see how creative work supports marketing in a global environment.
* Fintech and wealth management exposure: Learn to communicate financial and investment products visually - a specialised skill within the fintech and wealth management industry.
* Ownership and visibility: Work closely with channel owners and the wider Marketing team, with direct visibility of how your work is used and how it performs.

**Candidate Profile**

* 0–1 years of experience in design, video editing or multimedia production. Fresh graduates with a strong portfolio are encouraged to apply.
* A degree or diploma in Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Animation, Film, Fine Arts or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience demonstrated through a portfolio.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects for video and motion work, and Photoshop and Illustrator for design.
* Comfortable producing collateral in Canva, including working within existing brand templates.
* Interest in working hands-on with AI video and image generation tools.
* A portfolio demonstrating design and video work.
* Strong attention to detail, an openness to feedback and iteration, and the ability to manage several deadlines at once.
* Interest in fintech, financial services or investment content is a bonus.

**How to Apply**

Applications are invited from candidates who meet the above profile and are keen to build a career in design and video production within the fintech and wealth management industry. Interested candidates can send their applications, along with a portfolio or showreel, to career@kristal.ai.

title: Technical Implementation Consultant
description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
**The Challenge**
Due to rapid growth and an increased demand for our platform, OneTrust is seeking a Technical Implementation Consultant. The Technical Implementation Consultant role is one of the key pieces of the OneTrust architecture. After the sales process, consultants are the key contact in driving and building the relationship, implementing the solution, and managing the expectations of the customer. Technical Implementation consultants work across the technical modules. As a Technical Implementation Consultant, you will be responsible for the customer relationship and will work directly with our customers to . The role is one of the most important as it is the bridge between OneTrust and the customer, helping the business grow by identifying product enhancements and relaying them between the customer and OneTrust Product teams.
  
  
**Our Team**
The Content Customization team is unique team with incredible talent. This team combines a fine-tuned project management discipline alongside superb technical acumen sprinkled with stunning design chops. Not only that, but we build on top of 2 world-class, customer-friendly CMS and LMS platforms. Furthermore, we operate like a boutique agency inside the OneTrust Ethics Professional Services Team.
  
  
**Your Mission**
**As a Technical Implementation Consultant, You Will**
Oversee the technical implementation and platform adoption for customer projects from start to finish.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing web-based portals and pages based on customer assets and brand guidelines on our CMS tool.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing branding and creating custom courses with customer assets and brand guidelines on our learning authoring tool.
  
  
Use your experience across a broad range of front-end technologies including HTML and CSS.
  
  
Use your design experience using wireframing tools like Figma and storyboarding in tools like Fig-jam.
  
  
Use or deepen your experience with the Adobe suite of products to create assets to use in creative projects.
  
  
Use or deepen your knowledge of Instructional Design.
  
  
Use or deepen your experience with web accessibility standards (ADA &WCAG).
  
  
Work closely with UI/UX design, marketing, product management and engineering on project goals and requirements.
  
  
Prioritize and drive resolution on escalated customer issues.
  
  
Complete internal and project documentation.
  
  
Seek opportunities in day-to-day workflow to improve quality and efficiency from ideation to deployment.
  
  
Document processes and workflows in shareable documents for future use and adoption.
  
  
Document project progress in our CRM tool (Salesforce)
  
  
Be an advocate for our customers by representing their issues to Product Management and Software Engineering with a focus on steering the OneTrust roadmap.
  
  
Monitor and analyse the customer’s adoption of our solution features and functionality to provide leadership with an understanding of their overall business needs as they relate to our products.
  
  
Provide strategic and tactical support for Sales, Professional Services, and Business Development
  
  
You will also act as system and regulatory best practice expert, drawing from a plethora of consulting experience to advise customers on optimization of privacy & ethics program(s). Act as the customer advocate. Seamlessly transition ownership and action plan back to involved teams. Show ownership of issues, engage customers, establish urgent priorities, and implement resolution plan. Able to resolve simple to moderate issues with minimal management intervention. Ability to interpret and deliver on custom SOW customer projects.
  
  
**Your Experience Includes**
BA/BS OR MS in Computer Science, Web Design/Development [Bootcamp friendly], Engineering Management or Information Technology/Systems
  
  
2 – 5 years of relevant experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, design, technical consulting; with expertise in architecting, supporting and/or rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
  
  
Experience working with front-end technologies and design frameworks.
  
  
Effective customer-facing relationship building skills. Proven success in and genuine enthusiasm for working directly with customer(s).
  
  
Proven ability to engage across corporate functions (Professional Services, Support and Product Management).
  
  
Previous end-to-end implementation experience, ideally on a SAAS platform/product or creative agency.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to chair meetings or host trainings.
  
  
An understanding of the following tech/tools: HTML, CSS, Figma (or any wireframing tool), Acquia (or any CMS), Gomo (or any learning authoring tool), Salesforce, Jira – a plus, SSO, Domain Management.
  
  
Ability to build relationships across stakeholders in marketing, product, sales, and engineering.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft suite of products.
  
  
**Extra Awesome**
Knowledge of HTTP, SSO, SCORM packages, domain management.
  
  
Knowledge of Learning Management Systems.
  
  
Functional experience in the field (Privacy, Ethics or GRC)
  
  
Industry Certifications (CIPP/E, CIPM, GRCP, CPA, CISA, LPEC, etc.)
  
  
Experience dealing with senior management (C-Level) across multiple customers.
  
  
Language skills (German, French, Spanish, or Italian)
  
  
Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data
  
  
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
**.**
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
  
  
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Product Analyst**

**Experience:**
1-2yrs

**Location:**
Bengaluru
**(Onsite only)**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a curious, analytical, and highly communicative Product Analyst to join our Product team. This role goes well beyond dashboards and reporting—you will partner closely with Product Managers, Design, Engineering, Customer Success, and customers themselves to help shape what we build and why.

You will combine data-driven thinking with deep product understanding, transforming customer problems, market insights, and competitive intelligence into well-defined product requirements. From discovery through release and adoption, you will play a key role in ensuring we deliver solutions that create measurable value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Discovery & Research**

* Conduct deep research into customer workflows, industry trends, emerging technologies, and market opportunities.
* Perform competitor analysis to understand positioning, identify feature gaps, and recommend strategic improvements.
* Gather and synthesize feedback from customers, internal stakeholders, and support teams into actionable product insights.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured hypotheses and product recommendations.

**Product Requirements & Documentation**

* Draft high-quality Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
* Use AI-assisted research and documentation tools (including Claude Skills or similar workflows) to accelerate research, requirement gathering, and documentation while maintaining high quality and accuracy.
* Ensure product specifications are complete, testable, and clearly understood by engineering and design teams.
* Maintain documentation throughout the product lifecycle as requirements evolve.

**Product Validation & Quality**

* Participate in feature reviews, QA demonstrations, and pre-release validations to verify that delivered functionality aligns with product intent and customer expectations.
* Provide product sign-off or recommend changes before features are released.
* Collaborate with QA and Engineering to identify functional gaps, usability issues, and edge cases early in the development process.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Participate in customer meetings, discovery sessions, implementation discussions, and feedback calls.
* Clearly communicate product capabilities, limitations, and roadmap decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Support customer-facing teams by helping explain new functionality and gather structured feedback for future improvements.
* Deliver product demonstrations and contribute to customer training sessions when required.

**Product Analytics**

* Define and monitor product KPIs, adoption metrics, engagement trends, and feature success measures.
* Analyze user behavior, funnels, retention, and usage patterns to inform product decisions.
* Build evidence-based recommendations using quantitative and qualitative data rather than intuition alone.
* Evaluate product experiments and recommend next steps based on measurable outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* Experience writing PRDs, user stories, functional specifications, or similar product documentation.
* Ability to conduct independent research and convert findings into practical product recommendations.
* Comfort working directly with customers and presenting ideas to cross-functional teams.
* Experience participating in feature validation or QA reviews with a product mindset.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints when making recommendations.
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership.

**Nice to Have**

While not required, we would especially value candidates who have worked on digital transformation initiatives within construction, engineering, infrastructure, or field operations organizations. Experience in these environments can provide useful context for understanding operational workflows and user needs, but we welcome applicants from all industries with strong product and analytical capabilities.

**Success in This Role**

**A successful Product Analyst will:**

* Produce clear, thoughtful, and implementation-ready PRDs.
* Surface meaningful insights through research and competitive analysis.
* Help ensure features meet both business goals and customer expectations before release.
* Confidently represent the Product team in customer conversations and training sessions.
* Act as a trusted partner to Product Management by combining analytical rigor with strong communication and sound product judgment.

title: Visual Designer
description:
**Location:**
Jayanagar, Bengaluru — in office
  
  
**Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience:**
1-2 years
  
  
**Compensation:**
the posted range is fixed pay; ESOPs come over and above.
  
  
**About Kulfi**
Kulfi is where couples in India spend time together, even when they can't be in the same place.
  
  
About 100 million unmarried Indian couples don't get to be together most nights. Different cities, different homes, parents around. A phone is all they have. So they join a class just to be near each other, or stay on a one-way call, or watch a movie over video. They do all this for love, and nothing was built for them.
  
  
We are building that. Kulfi is a digital experiences app for couples, and close to a million people already use it. We did not get here by spending. Daily users grew 4x in 30 days this summer. We added 100,000 users in the first 20 days of August without paying for a single ad. 80% of all play happens between 9pm and midnight. That is bedtime, and we own it. We are backed by South Park Commons and by founders and CEOs from Swiggy, Mosaic Wellness, Snitch and Moonshot.
  
  
Next is an AI personalization engine for games. Every couple gets a new game every day, made for them on the spot from what they like. Our team already ships a new game in about two days. No couple should run out of things to do together.
  
  
India has more couples than any other country. We want every one of them on Kulfi.
  
  
We are a small, high-intensity team. Your work will reach real users quickly, and you will be expected to notice what is broken—not wait for someone else to notice it for you.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
**Dual Craft: App UI & Game UI/Art**

* App Surface Design: Design the core mobile experience in Figma—onboarding, couple-pairing flows, home navigation, profile identities, and ambient night-time chat interfaces.
* Game UI & In-Game HUDs: Design specialized, tactile interfaces for 2-player micro-games—turn indicators, interactive boards, card layouts, answer reveals, countdown timers, and victory/loss screens.
* Visual Art & Thematic Assets: Produce bespoke visual assets, illustrations, avatars, thematic stickers, and expressive game props tailored to intimate couple rituals and 48-hour game drops.
* Micro-Interactions & "Game Feel": Combine visual art with motion, haptics, and particle/celebration effects (Lottie, Rive, or Figma motion) so interactions feel alive, physical, and emotionally rewarding.

**AI-Native Visual Production**

* Generative Art Engine: Produce production-grade game art, character sets, and backgrounds.
* Interactive Prototyping with AI: Use AI tools (Codex, Claude) to build functional, playable games end-to-end using our in-house SDK.

**Systems**

* Zero-Friction Dev Handoff: Provide clean exports, asset slices, tokenized specs, and explicit edge-case states (disconnections, partner inactive, asymmetric screen sizes).

What we are looking for
  
  

* Exceptional Taste & Visual Artistry
* Strong Core Fundamentals: Demonstrated mastery of composition, color theory, stylized 2D art, typography, and visual balance.
* Dual Fluent (App + Game): You understand that an app screen demands clarity and low cognitive load, while a game screen demands immersion, tactile feedback, and delight.
* Emotionally Resonant Style: Intuition for novel, cozy, and playful aesthetics suitable for late-night mobile interactions.
* AI as a Visual Multiplier
* Not Just a Prompt Typist: You actively direct, iterate, and stylize raw AI outputs into finished, cohesive product artwork.
* Obsessive Tool Exploration: You continuously tinker with bleeding-edge visual AI models, plugins, and control nets to push what a 1-person design pod can output.
* Super Curiosity & High Agency
* Unprompted Output: A rich body of personal creative work—indie games, card game mockups, digital illustration series, custom sticker packs, or concept apps.
* Extreme Self-Direction: When an asset is missing or experience is lagging, you fix or report it yourself immediately rather than waiting for an external push or PM spec.

Bonus points (helpful, not required)
  
  

* Background in sketching or art as a hobby, project or profession.
* Basic understanding of mobile rendering constraints (vector optimization, texture atlas sizing, WebGL, or Canvas).

What success looks like
  
  
**Within 30 Days:**

* Audit Kulfi’s existing app surfaces and active games; map visual inconsistencies and fix them.
* Ship your first live game.

Interview process
  
  

* Portfolio Screen: Rigorous filter on visual taste, craft, 2D art skill, and UI structure (no generic templates).
* 15-Minute Intro Screen: Evaluates taste influences, creative appetite, and personal agency.
* 90-Minute Live Visual & Game Jam.
* 45-Minute Founder Chat: Deep dive on creative ambition, speed of iteration, and cultural alignment.
* Reference Checks

Calling anyone at Kulfi directly or contacting them on WhatsApp will result in immediate rejection of your application.
