title: Sr. Content Designer
description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
  
  
**About the Role :**
We're looking for a Sr. Content Designer to shape how people experience our product through words — across screens, flows, and increasingly, conversations with AI. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Research, and our AI/ML teams to craft content that's clear, useful, and on-brand, whether it's a button label, an onboarding flow, or a multi-turn exchange with an AI assistant.
  
  
This role is for someone who thinks in systems, writes with precision, and is genuinely energized by the shift toward conversational and AI-generated interfaces — not just traditional UI copy.
  
  
**What You'll Do :**

* Own content design end-to-end for a product area: from early flow sketches through shipped, measured experiences.
* Design conversational flows for chat-based and voice interfaces, including multi-turn dialogue, disambiguation, error recovery, and graceful fallback when the AI doesn't know the answer.
* Write, test, and iterate on prompts and system instructions that shape AI-generated content surfaced to users — balancing tone, accuracy, brevity, and safety.
* Partner with ML/AI engineers to evaluate model outputs for voice, clarity, bias, and hallucination risk, and build feedback loops to improve them over time.
* Build and maintain content patterns, voice & tone guidelines, and a scalable content design system that covers both static UI and dynamic/AI-generated content.
* Collaborate with PMs, designers, and researchers from discovery through delivery; represent the user's need for clarity in every product decision.
* Use qualitative research and quantitative metrics (task success, drop-off, CSAT, containment rate for AI flows) to inform and defend content decisions.
* Review and elevate the work of other writers and designers; mentor junior content designers.
* Advocate for accessible, inclusive, plain-language content across the product.

**What We're Looking For :**

* 5+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or a closely related field, with at least 1–2 years working on conversational or AI-driven surfaces.
* Conversational design experience — you've designed chatbot, voice assistant, or AI-agent flows and understand turn-taking, context handling, and failure states.
* Hands-on prompting / prompt engineering experience — you've written and refined prompts or system instructions for LLM-powered features, and you can talk concretely about how prompt structure affects tone, reliability, and safety of output.
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong craft in traditional UX writing and at least one project involving conversational or generative AI content.
* Comfort working directly with AI/ML teams — reading model outputs critically, giving structured feedback, and iterating quickly.
* Strong systems thinking: you can design a single string and a scalable pattern in the same day.
* Excellent editing skills and an ear for voice, tone, and plain language.
* Experience partnering cross-functionally in a fast-moving, ambiguous product environment.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive writing practices.
* Experience with tools like Figma, Ditto (or a similar content design/collaboration platform), a content-ops/localization platform, and an LLM playground or console (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, or similar).

**Nice to Have :**

* Experience building a conversational design system or an AI content style guide from scratch.
* Familiarity with agentic or RAG-based product patterns, multi-modal AI experiences, or evaluation frameworks for generative content.
* Background in linguistics, taxonomy, or information architecture.
* Prior experience shipping AI features at a B2B SaaS or Martech/AI company.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.
  
  
*We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com*

* Agentic Automation – Position the role around orchestrating AI agents, automation, systems, and human decision-making, not just designing workflows.

In a UX Designer role, you’ll take on complex tasks and transform them into intuitive, accessible, and easy-to-use designs for users around the world —ranging from novice to sophisticated users. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, visual designers, and technical designers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities.

AND…
  
  

* Experience collaborating with and influencing Product Management and Engineering counterparts.
* Experience conducting UX research to amplify research and design impact.

* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Experience Design and Event Innovation professional
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Experience Design And Event Innovation Professional**
EY Global Delivery Services | Brand, Marketing and Communications | Global Flagship Events and Experiences
  
  
**Role focus**
This role will help make our flagship events more memorable, immersive and future-facing.
  
  
Let us introduce you to the job offer by EY GDS, Brand, Marketing and Communications, India - a member of the global integrated service delivery centre network by EY.
  
  
Global Delivery Services (GDS) comprises 80,000 professionals who deliver strategic support to EY member firms. The team spans all EY geographies, practices, service lines, sectors and competencies to provide deeply integrated services resulting in efficient and world-class solutions.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
At EY Global Delivery Services (GDS), we work hand in hand with the business to build awareness of our services and solutions; to bring our purpose - building a better working world - to life for our people, clients and communities; to engage our people and build a high performing culture; and to build the commercial value and emotional resonance of the EY and the GDS brand.
  
  
We are looking for an Experience Design and Event Innovation professional to help create distinctive, memorable and future-facing flagship experiences for EY GDS. This role is for someone who can think beyond event logistics and bring together storytelling, audience insight, design thinking, technology, immersion and creative execution to shape experiences that people remember, talk about and act on.
  
  
You will work in a fast-paced, global environment to support high-impact leadership events, client experiences, internal flagship programmes, milestone moments, innovation showcases and integrated brand experiences. You will partner with stakeholders, creative teams, production partners, designers, vendors and internal teams across EY to transform business priorities into meaningful audience journeys.
  
  
Your key responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for a marketing and events professional with the ability to translate strategy into engaging experience concepts. You must be able to understand business objectives, audience expectations and brand priorities, and convert them into compelling event formats, experience journeys and creative interventions.
  
  
You should be a curious and imaginative thinker with strong project management skills. As part of the Global Flagship Events and Experiences team, your key responsibilities will include designing audience journeys, shaping event concepts, developing immersive formats, supporting creative production, coordinating with internal and external partners, and bringing fresh ideas to high-visibility experiences.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Understand business priorities, audience needs and the strategic role of flagship experiences, and translate them into engaging event concepts and audience journeys.
* Design end-to-end experience flows across pre-event, live event and post-event moments.
* Bring creative ideas for immersive formats, stage experiences, installations, showcases, leadership engagements, networking formats and interactive sessions.
* Work closely with internal designers, content teams, production partners, vendors and stakeholders to convert ideas into executable experience plans.
* Support the development of event narratives, show flows, speaker journeys, visual experience cues and audience engagement moments.
* Identify opportunities to use technology, AI, digital tools, multimedia and emerging formats to make events more engaging and memorable.
* Bring a strong audience-first lens to event planning, ensuring that every experience has a clear purpose, emotional hook and measurable outcome.
* Support vendor briefing, creative evaluation, production planning and on-ground execution.
* Encourage creative and innovative thinking to bring fresh perspectives to flagship event formats.
* Manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail, deadlines and quality.
* Collaborate across a matrixed organisation and build relationships with stakeholders without direct authority.
* Ensure all event experiences align with EY brand identity, tone, purpose and quality expectations.

Skills and attributes for success
  
  
We seek a highly skilled and dynamic professional who can bring a fresh perspective to the Global Flagship Events and Experiences team. In this role, you will be responsible for contributing to flagship experiences that are audience-centric, brand-aligned and outcome-led.
  
  

* Strong creative thinking and experience design orientation.
* Ability to understand audience motivations and map meaningful experience journeys.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to translate business messages into engaging event formats.
* Exposure to experiential marketing, event production, brand activations, exhibitions, corporate events, innovation showcases or similar experience-led formats.
* Good understanding of stagecraft, visual storytelling, spatial design, event flow and audience engagement.
* Ability to work with creative, production and vendor teams from concept to execution.
* Strong project management, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to bring structure to early-stage ideas.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A keen interest in technology, multimedia, AI-enabled experiences and emerging event formats.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across time zones in a flexible and agile environment.
* High ownership, high energy and strong attention to detail.

To qualify for the role, you must have
  
  

* Fluent English skills, written and verbal.
* 3-5 years of experience in events, experiential marketing, brand activations, marketing communications, experience design, creative production or related roles.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience supporting medium to large-scale events, activations, campaigns or experience-led programmes.
* Ability to work with internal teams, creative partners, agencies and vendors.

Ideally, you'll also have
  
  

* Previous experience in a large, matrixed organisation.
* Prior experience with an experiential marketing agency, B2B organisation, technology company, consulting firm, creative agency, event production company or brand experience team.
* Exposure to leadership events, client experiences, innovation centres, exhibitions, conferences or internal culture-building programmes.
* Familiarity with digital event tools, AI tools, content production tools or collaboration platforms.
* An interest in design thinking, behavioural insights, storytelling, technology and audience engagement.

What we offer
  
  
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: UX Engineer
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
The Elastic IT team is shifting beyond standard chat interfaces to craft the next frontier of generative and agentic AI experiences. We are looking for an innovative UX & Front End Engineer to join our team to bridge the gap between powerful AI capabilities and intuitive, delightful user interfaces that accelerate productivity across the entire organization.
  
  
Our ideal candidate is a skilled front-end engineer with hands-on experience designing and building AI user experiences (e.g., streaming text, dynamic prompt workflows, agent reasoning visualizations, and multi-modal interaction patterns). In this role, you will leverage the latest AI technologies and the Elastic Stack (including ESRE, Agent Builder, Workflows and eUI) to build high-performance front-end applications for a suite of internal products and platforms. Driven by a user-centered mindset, you will act as a key collaborator between AI back-end engineers, product managers, and user groups to turn complex AI reasoning into seamless human-AI interactions. By shaping how enterprise users interact with generative AI, you will enable our global workforce while showcasing the boundary-pushing capabilities of Elastic's products.
  
  
Are you ready to design and build the interfaces that supercharge enterprise productivity and prove what’s possible with Elastic? Join us to create AI user experiences that turn collective knowledge into instant action, empowering everyone at Elastic to achieve more.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* AI UI/UX Design & Implementation: Translate complex generative and agentic AI processes into intuitive, responsive, and engaging front-end interfaces.
* Front-End Architecture: Design, build, and maintain front-end UI component libraries. These libraries should be scalable, accessible, and reusable and will be created for generative AI interactions. You will use modern frameworks like React and TypeScript.
* Human-AI Interaction Patterns: Prototype and implement novel interaction patterns for conversational AI, agent execution visibility (thought logs, tool calls), prompt systems, and rich dynamic outputs.

* Optimize UI rendering, animations, and widget performance for constrained CPU, RAM, and GPU environments.

* Ensure reliability and responsiveness of UIs on systems with limited storage, small screens, or low refresh rates.
* Develop clean, responsive web interfaces for configuration dashboards, control panels, or monitoring tools using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks.
* Integrate UI components with device APIs through REST, WebSockets, or lightweight local services.
* Ensure consistent design and smooth interaction flow across on‑device and web UIs.

* Solid understanding of graphical UI elements, layout principles, and interaction flows.
* Familiarity with UI toolkits commonly used on embedded Linux systems (Qt/QML, LVGL, Flutter, GTK+, etc.).
* Proficiency with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic responsive design patterns.
* Experience with Linux command‑line tools for debugging UI performance or system behaviour.
* Understanding of embedded Linux fundamentals: file systems, processes, permissions, services.

* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs

**Position Summary**
**Customer**

Senior Consultant or equivalent

**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 6-9 years of experience in product management, with demonstrated evidence of owning product decisions - not just managing backlogs

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

title: Specialist, Tech capability
description:
**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**
Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.
  
  
For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
  
  
Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
  
  
Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and futureproofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.
  
  
Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Own requirements and functional analysis for the Digital Commerce capability, translating brand and business needs into delivery-ready specifications for the squad. Apply functional knowledge of digital commerce platforms to challenge, refine, and validate requirements before they enter development.
  
  

* Own requirements and functional analysis for the Shopify capability within the Digital Delivery function, translating business goals into delivery-ready requirements for the squad.
* Ensure business requirements are translated into well-defined features, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and executable delivery outcomes before they enter development.
* Delivered features meet their agreed acceptance criteria at UAT, minimizing defects traced back to unclear or incomplete requirements.
* Produce functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and maintain functional documentation in Confluence covering process flows, decisions, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and change history.
* Produce UAT test scenarios, defect closure records, and requirements traceability from business need through to sign-off.
* Provide quality data to support the monthly SLA report presented back to the brands.
* Participate in discovery workshops with functional leads and business stakeholders to shape and clarify requirements.
* Support PI and sprint planning by refining requirements ready for estimation, identifying cross-functional and cross-system dependencies, and clarifying scope before commitment.
* Analyse customer feedback, support tickets, operational issues, and behavioral data using analytics platforms such as GA4 to identify recurring pain points and improvement opportunities, informing business outcomes such as conversion, AOV and adoption.

**What You’ll Need To Succeed**

* 6 to 9 years in business or functional analysis within digital commerce.
* Experience analyzing and specifying requirements on SFCC or Shopify or Shopify Plus.
* Strong functional knowledge of capability, able to challenge and shape business requirements rather than only document them.
* Experience producing user stories and acceptance criteria and supporting UAT through to defect closure and sign-off.
* Usage proficiency in Jira and Confluence for backlog management and functional documentation.
* Ability to analyse business, product, and customer data to generate actionable insights,

diagnose KPI performance, identify root causes, and recommend clear next steps to
  
  
improve outcomes across digital commerce journeys.
  
  

* Experience using generative AI tools to support analysis and documentation.
* Certification in business analysis or agile delivery is nice to have.
* Preferred Profile: Retail or e-commerce domain experience. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and to operate effectively as a senior individual contributor. Profiles such as Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst, or Technical Analyst in digital commerce

**What We Can Offer You**
With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
  
  
We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
  
  
**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
  
  
**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
  
  
We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

Leena AI is a leader in
**Agentic AI**

**Nestlé, Puma, Coca-Cola, Sony, and Etihad Airways.**
Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, Leena AI has secured over $40M in financing from top-tier investors including Greycroft, Bessemer Venture Partners, B Capital, and Y Combinator.
  
  
**Role Overview**
This role owns leena.ai website end-to-end: shipping website changes, standing up A/B testing, and driving conversion optimization. It also owns the initial PLG surface: improving the sandbox experience and building a lightweight product wedge that gives prospects self-serve value before a sales conversation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Website Changes & Page Development
* Own the leena.ai codebase (Next.js / React deployed on Cloudflare); ship new pages, redesigns, and campaign landing pages within days, not sprints.
* Implement responsive, accessible, and performant front-end code aligned with the Design team's specs.
* Build reusable page templates and component libraries so Marketing can compose pages with minimal engineering lift.
* Manage deployment pipelines, staging environments, and site reliability (uptime, Core Web Vitals, page speed).
* A/B Testing Infrastructure
* Evaluate and implement an A/B testing infrastructure that can be integrated with the existing analytics stack.
* Build the plumbing: experiment assignment, event tracking, statistical significance reporting, and audience segmentation.
* Create a self-serve experimentation workflow so Marketing and Growth can launch, monitor, and conclude tests without engineering tickets.
* Document experimentation standards (sample size, run time, success metrics) for the team.
* Conversion-Rate Optimization
* Instrument the full visitor funnel — landing → page scroll → CTA click → demo form submit → confirmation with event-level tracking (GA4, Segment, or equivalent).
* Analyze conversion data by page, traffic source, geography, and device to identify drop-off points.
* Run iterative experiments on headlines, hero sections, social proof, form fields, and CTA placement to improve demo-request conversion rate.
* Partner with the Marketing teams to close the loop from website lead to qualified pipeline, feeding learnings back into page design.
* Sandbox & Product Wedge
* Own the Leena sandbox experience reduce setup friction, improve time-to-value.
* Build and iterate on a product wedge: a self-serve tool on leena.ai (e.g., HR ticket analyzer, automation ROI calculator) that uses Leena's domain model to deliver value a general-purpose LLM can't replicate.
* Instrument the wedge funnel; signups, activation, engagement, PQL conversion.
* Work with Product to define what "product-qualified" means and how wedge usage maps to enterprise buying intent.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of professional front-end or full-stack web development experience.
* Strong proficiency in React and Next.js (SSR, SSG, API routes, image optimization).
* Solid HTML/CSS fundamentals; responsive layouts, accessibility (WCAG 2.1), cross-browser compatibility.
* Experience with at least one A/B testing or feature-flagging tool (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, VWO, or custom).
* Familiarity with web analytics platforms (GA4, Segment, Mixpanel, or Amplitude) and event instrumentation.
* Comfortable with CI/CD workflows, Git, and deploying to modern hosting platforms (Cloudflare Pages/Workers, Vercel, or AWS).
* Light backend experience is a plus: our site runs on Cloudflare Workers, so experience writing edge logic, simple APIs, or redirects in JS/TS (Workers, Pages, KV/D1) helps
* Understanding of Core Web Vitals and performance optimization (Lighthouse scores, lazy loading, bundle splitting).
* Strong communication skills; able to work directly with Marketing, Design, and GTM stakeholders without a PM intermediary.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Experience at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company, especially in a growth or marketing-engineering role.
* Experience at a startup/ fast-paced growth teams
* Hands-on CRO experience; has personally run and analyzed multivariate tests that moved conversion metrics.
* Familiarity with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi) for marketing-managed content is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of SEO technical fundamentals (structured data, sitemap management, canonical tags, page speed).
* Exposure to tools like Hotjar, FullStory, or Microsoft Clarity for session recording and heatmap analysis.
* Design sensibility; can translate a Figma comp to pixel-accurate, polished UI without heavy design oversight.
* Basic data/SQL skills for pulling conversion funnel data from a warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery).

It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Rippling, Design is central to our mission to free smart people to tackle hard problems. We build products that automate the operational complexity of running a business — from HR and payroll to IT and finance — so our customers can focus on what matters most. In a world of fragmented, outdated systems, we’re creating a unified platform where thoughtful design turns complexity into clarity, confidence, and action.
  
  
As Product Design Lead for Tasks & Notifications, you’ll ensure our customers are working on the right thing at the right time. You’ll reimagine how users understand what matters, prioritize their work, and take action. You’ll also shape the platform tools that product teams will use to bring the right information and work to users at the right moment. You’ll also define the principles, templates, and tiering models that maintain quality across approximately 2,500+ templates and 1MM+ daily sends, giving users fewer, more relevant messages instead of more noise.
  
  
You’ll also lead design for Sandbox, a safe testing environment that gives IT administrators a copy of their production instance. You’ll help customers confidently build and validate settings, permissions, integrations, and workflows without affecting live data or employees.
  
  
Success in this role requires a designer who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys partnering closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional teams, and can quickly develop deep expertise in new domains. Designers at Rippling are product builders. AI isn't just something we design, it’s fundamental to how we work from exploration and prototyping to shipping world-class customer experiences.
  
  
**About The Team**
Developer Platform builds the capabilities and experiences that help Rippling’s products work together as one coherent system. The team operates across product boundaries, solving foundational problems that affect how customers configure, understand, and interact with Rippling.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define and drive the design vision for Inbox and Notifications, improving today’s experience while shaping how users discover, prioritize, and act on information across in-product, mobile, email, and other surfaces.
* Design systems that handle high volumes of tasks, alerts, approvals, and updates while accounting for prioritization, permissions, deadlines, and diverse user needs.
* Establish the principles, interaction patterns, quality standards, and governance that help teams create consistent notifications while moving quickly and addressing domain-specific needs.
* Lead end-to-end design for Sandbox, helping IT administrators safely configure, test, validate, and learn without introducing risk to their production environment.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows through research, data, customer conversations, and close partnership with customer-facing teams.
* Partner tightly with Product and Engineering to frame ambiguous problems, make high-velocity decisions, and ship with urgency while maintaining a high quality bar.
* Use AI throughout the design process from research synthesis and requirements development to prototyping and exploring intelligent product experiences.

**What You Will Need**

* 8+ years of end-to-end product design experience shipping complex, high-impact products from concept to launch and iterating based on what you learn.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking and the ability to turn messy, ambiguous problem spaces into simple, intuitive workflows.
* Experience designing complex SaaS, enterprise, platform, productivity, or workflow products across multiple personas, permissions, states, and dependencies.
* Strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect functionality into coherent end-to-end journeys, anticipate second-order effects, and balance platform consistency with individual product needs.
* Excellent interaction and visual design craft, including the ability to produce polished work across edge cases and communicate clear, build-ready specifications.
* Relentless customer focus, backed by a habit of studying real behavior, identifying meaningful pain points, and using evidence to guide design decisions.
* Active use of LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your design workflow whether for research, requirements, copy, or exploration.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, from crisp async write-ups to persuasive presentations that drive alignment and decisions.

title: Senior Creative (Hybrid) - AI Technologist
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
You are a creative coder, an inventor, and a technical artist. You are the person who hears an ambitious idea and immediately starts thinking about how to build it. As a Creative Hybrid (Creative AI Technologist) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the heart of the creative team, working with directors, designers, and strategists to apply technology in ways that change what the work can be. Code is your primary craft.
  
  
You build the prototypes, experiences, and tools that bring our most imaginative concepts to life. You move fluidly from fast, AI-assisted “vibe-coding” for quick conceptual sketches to production-ready frameworks like React and Next.js when structure matters. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are tuned into what is happening at the edges of technology, brand, and culture.
  
  
You operate as the studio’s R&D engine. You proactively explore, test, and master emerging technologies, from generative AI and creative coding frameworks to AR/VR and physical computing, and share what you discover to raise the bar for everyone around you. You have a sharp instinct for where technology makes the work better and where it gets in the way. That instinct is what makes you genuinely useful, not just technically capable.
  
  
You also work directly with clients and BCG case teams. You translate technical possibilities into ideas people get excited about. You lead workshops, shape narratives, and help organizations understand not just what AI can do but how to make it work inside their actual creative process.
  
  
**Day To Day, You Will**

* Build and manage end-to-end creative pipelines, not single artefacts, using prompt chains, agentic workflows, and node-based systems to generate high-fidelity, on-brand creative at scale. You know the difference between a tool and a pipeline and you build the latter
* Design AI-enabled systems where the output improves with every run. That means defining evaluation criteria, building quality gates, and creating feedback loops between what gets made and what actually works
* Audit and redesign creative workflows end-to-end, finding the places where a well-built system saves hours of manual work without sacrificing craft
* Translate creative and strategic briefs into working prototypes, whether that is a real-time 3D visualization, a prompt-driven generative tool for designers, an interactive brand experience, or something that did not exist as a category until you built it
* Bring new capabilities into the studio before anyone asks for them. You evaluate models, APIs, and platforms, form a view on what matters, and build the proof of concept that makes the case
* Support live project teams on technically complex client work, developing bespoke digital solutions and AI-powered tools in direct response to what the brief demands
* Build capability across the studio. You run workshops, share discoveries, and help designers, producers, and consultants understand what is possible and how to use it well
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and with enthusiasm, to creative directors, to clients, to a room full of people who have never touched a model. You make the technical feel accessible without making it feel smaller

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A degree in Computer Science, Creative Technology, Engineering, Media Arts, or a related field
* 4+ years working in creative technology, digital innovation, or a hybrid role, ideally in an agency, innovation lab, or media and technology environment
* Fluency in Python, JavaScript, or similar, with a track record of building things from idea to working execution
* Real, working experience with generative AI tools and platforms, such as Runway, Flux, ComfyUI, or similar, applied in a creative context
* Experience building agentic systems and pipelines: prompt taxonomies, evaluation rubrics, multi-step workflows, API orchestration. You understand RAG, tool use, and context windows at a working level
* Experience with automation frameworks, systems integration, and the judgment to know when to build versus when to connect
* An understanding of how brands work and how digital moments can create something people remember
* Confidence presenting to and working with clients, and the ability to lead a session, shape a narrative, and guide a review

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. GDS comprises a diverse group of talented design professionals across video, content, digital design, and more—all working collaboratively to deliver the most cutting-edge design solutions.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You're Good AT**

* Turning a vague brief into a working prototype before the meeting is over
* Writing inventive code across the full range, from a fast vibe-coded sketch in Cursor or Claude Code to a production-grade React or Next.js application, and knowing which mode the moment calls for
* Working with current frontier-model tooling across text, image, video, and audio, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Flux, Veo, Runway, ComfyUI, v0, and connecting them into systems rather than reaching for them one at a time
* Building agentic workflows where models, APIs, and tools are stitched together into something that reasons, evaluates, and iterates. You are at home in node-based systems and you can explain why the architecture is clever
* Knowing when to prompt-engineer, when to fine-tune, and when to build a deterministic step. You understand the trade-offs and you make the call
* Moving between creative and technical contexts without losing the thread of either. You think like a maker in both rooms
* Explaining what is technically possible in a way that gets non-technical people genuinely interested, not just nodding along
* Balancing experimentation with delivery, knowing when to push and when to ship

We are Design Studios, an in-house creative agency comprised of cutting-edge professionals creating premium designs. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of design strategists, creative leaders, and digital experts. We craft powerful design stories for BCG to deliver inspiring solutions to our clients’ challenges. As part of BCG, Design Studios partners with consultants and clients to shape our brand by elevating our work through the power of design. We offer guidance and orientation through a strategic and audience-centric approach, and apply design, technology, and media solutions to take BCG’s achievements to the next level.
  
  
As bold design leaders, we are fresh, punchy, and playful, while committed to delivering premium business excellence. We recognize how to transform complex ideas into compelling visual experiences, and how to activate new commercial opportunities at the intersection of business and design. We value innovation, co-creation, inspiration, and the business impact that design achieves. We believe in the art of the possible and in applying creative solutions to business challenges. We believe we can advance the world by conquering its complexity through a universal human language—design.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

with

title: Venture Fellow - Internship
description:
Aadi Labs is a venture creation studio. We help founders turn promising ideas into working products, first customers and the foundations of real companies, and we build some of those companies ourselves, with Venture Fellows leading the work.

You will own a real function inside an early-stage venture for six months: real users, real numbers, real consequences if something does not work.

**What you will actually do**

Depending on the venture and the function you choose, that could mean running growth experiments and watching the numbers move, shipping product decisions that get tested by real users within days, writing and deploying code that goes live the same week, or designing the first experience a customer ever sees of something that did not exist a month ago. You will not be handed a six-month roadmap on day one. You will be handed a problem and the room to go solve it.

**Who this is for**

AI is already part of how you work daily. You use it to get more done than your headcount would suggest, not as a novelty you dabble in occasionally. You want responsibility earlier than a conventional internship gives you, and you are comfortable with a role that is not fully defined yet.

Prior experience in a function helps, but a real track record of building or shipping something, anywhere, counts for more than a résumé line.

**Pick your track**
— Venture Fellows lead one of five functions. You choose which one you are applying for on our site.

* **Growth**
   — positioning, acquisition and retention, with AI handling the busywork so your judgment goes toward what to test next.
* **Product**
   — the customer, the first use case, the smallest version worth shipping, prototyped with AI to move at founder speed.
* **Engineering**
   — production code, using AI coding tools to multiply your own output.
* **Design**
   — the end-to-end experience, from UX to the first impression a user gets.
* **Other**
   — sales, operations, customer success, or a function that doesn't fit neatly above.

**Logistics**
: 6 months · Remote or hybrid (Whitefield, Bangalore)

· Direct exposure to zero-to-one building, mentorship, real equity via ESOP, and a credible path to full-time or founding your own venture after.

title: Design Lead - Bangalore, India
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**About**
In 1931, an engineering draughtsman named Harry Beck redrew the map of the London Underground. He ignored geography, distorted distance, and reduced the world's most complicated transit system to something anyone could read. Beck understood that when a system gets complex enough, accuracy isn't the same thing as truth. The designer's job is to make the complex legible — so people can decide where to go.
  
  
**The role**
Bangalore is one of WisdomAI's largest and fastest-growing engineering hubs, and much of our platform is built there. We're hiring a Design Lead to be a core design partner to that team: owning major product areas, setting the craft bar on everything that ships from Bangalore, and growing into the office's design manager as the team grows.
  
  
The work spans our whole platform. Chat on Data, Live Apps, our Slack and Teams apps, MCP, our visualizations, and a major push into agents: always-on teammates for the enterprise, grounded in Wisdom's context engine. Every one of these has to feel like the same product, built by the same hands.
  
  
Design at WisdomAI
  
  
**Craft is the product.**
People make real decisions from what we show them. A chart that's technically correct but visually misleading is a failure. An answer that's right but illegible is a failure. Craft isn't decoration here. It's the product working.
  
  
**AI-native by default.**
Exploration often starts in an LLM — clarifying intent, mapping edge cases, pressure-testing a direction before a single frame exists. We prototype in code, move fluidly between Claude, Cursor, Paper, and Figma, and aren't precious about toolchain. We optimize for velocity and quality.
  
  
**Small and senior, on purpose.**
With today's AI tools, a handful of exceptional designers can have outsized impact. Everyone here owns real territory, and the team grows only when the bar stays this high. You'll work alongside a designer in Bangalore and the design team in San Mateo, directly with our VP of Design.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Coherence across the platform. Think in systems from the context engine outward, so a definition, an answer, a chart, or an agent behaves the same way in chat, in Slack, in a Live App, and over MCP.
* Agents. Define what a great enterprise agent feels like: how it takes on work, reports back, earns trust, asks before acting, and shows up where people already work.
* Live Apps. Customers build anything here: a daily brief that reads like the New York Times, a pricing simulator with deep sensitivity analysis, a dashboard on steroids, a mobile metric tracker. You'll design the best of them, and the templates and primitives that let everyone else build their own — for apps and for agents.
* The context engine. Make a deep, powerful layer of semantics, definitions, and governance legible to the people who configure it and the people who rely on it.
* Data visualization, occasionally. Our charts are a signature of the product. You'll pick up visualization work from time to time.

What you'll do
  
  

* Own product areas end to end, from customer discovery and problem framing with PMs and engineers through launch and iteration.
* Work side by side with engineers every day. Make design a fast, natural part of how Bangalore builds, not a handoff.
* Prototype early and often with AI tools, building working things rather than static frames, then carry validated concepts through full state coverage and system alignment.
* Set the craft bar in crits and in what ships. Share prompts, patterns, and process with the team.
* Extend our design system so new surfaces arrive coherent by default.
* Partner closely with design leadership in San Mateo across time zones, and help hire and grow the Bangalore design team.

What we're looking for
  
  

* 7+ years designing products, with a body of work in complex B2B, data, analytics, AI, or developer tools.
* A high bar for craft — visual, UI, and interaction. You notice the 1px things, and you know which ones matter.
* Impeccable taste, and opinions you can explain and defend.
* Sharp product thinking and a talent for taming complexity: you find the simple model hiding inside a sprawling system.
* A systems mind. You've driven coherence across many surfaces, not just polished a single flow.
* You work AI-natively today. You design with LLMs and AI prototyping or coding tools daily, and you can show how they've changed your work.
* You've mentored other designers and earned the trust of engineering teams, and you want to grow into leading a team.

Nice to haves
  
  

* You code, or consider yourself one part design engineer.
* An interest in data visualization. Experience is welcome but not required.
* You've designed agentic experiences, or templates and systems that other people build with.
* A background in data visualization or analytics.
* Experience on product teams that work across the US and India.

**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**

title: Product Design Lead
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**About this role:**

You will own how Refold AI's product feels to use, and build the team that keeps raising that bar. Our users configure AI agents that build and run enterprise integrations, which is powerful, technical work. Your job is to make it feel obvious.

You'll set the product design vision with the founders, stay hands-on from first sketch to shipped pixel, and grow the design function as we scale. You'll define the standard for interaction quality, the design system the product grows on, and how design works with product and engineering. If you want

to define how a new category of software works, and lead the people who build it, this is that seat.

**What you'll do:**

* Set the product design vision and strategy with the founders, and turn it into a roadmap the team can ship against.
* Stay hands-on: own key flows end to end, from research and wireframes to prototypes and production-ready UI.
* Turn complex, technical workflows (agent setup, connector configuration, debugging, monitoring) into interfaces anyone can use.
* Hire, mentor, and grow product designers, setting the craft bar and giving clear, regular feedback.
* Define how design works here: design reviews, critique, hand-off to engineering, and quality checks before launch.
* Partner with product and engineering leads from concept to launch, shaping the roadmap rather than just receiving it.
* Build a research practice: regular user conversations, usability tests, and product metrics that guide decisions.
* Own the product design system so engineering ships consistent UI without design in the loop.
* Lead new interaction patterns for AI: how users instruct, review, and trust what agents build.
* Work with the brand designer so the product and the brand feel like one company.

**What we're looking for:**

* 7+ years designing B2B SaaS, developer, or data products, including 2+ years leading designers or owning design for a product area. Experience band is flexible if the work is exceptional.
* A track record of shipped products you can walk us through, where your design decisions moved real outcomes.
* A systems thinker: you simplify complex, technical problems into clear flows, not just clean screens.
* Strong craft across interaction design, visual design, and prototyping, with deep Figma fluency. You still enjoy doing the work yourself.
* Experience hiring and mentoring designers, and building design processes and systems from scratch.
* Founding-calibre ownership: you set the bar and build from zero, without a playbook.
* Clear verbal and written communication, so you can align founders, engineers, and customers around a design direction.
* A portfolio with case studies that show your process, the trade-offs you made, the outcomes, and how you led others.

**Bonus points:**

* You've designed AI-native products, agent workflows, or integration and automation tools.
* You've built a design team at an early-stage startup, ideally as the first design hire.
* Front-end sensibility (HTML/CSS, React) or comfort prototyping in code.
* Motion and micro-interaction chops.
* You use AI tools to explore, prototype, and ship faster, and help your team do the same.

**How we work:**

* Ship weekly. We move fast and ship often.
* Bold ideas welcome. Creativity and out-of-the-box thinking, celebrated.
* High ownership, low ego. A young, talented team steering the ship together.

**What you’ll do**

* Design carousels, posts, stories, banners and ad creatives that stop the scroll

* Have 3 to 5 years of design experience, with a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia or Fine Arts, or a portfolio that makes up for the lack of one
* Are fluent in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)

title: Product Designer
description:
**Atomicwork**
is building agentic service management for modern IT teams. Atom, our AI assistant, answers and resolves employee requests where people already work, and our service desk gives IT teams one place to run everything behind it. The hard design problems here are new ones: how an agent shows its work, when it should ask a human, and how an IT team trusts software that acts on its own.

We are looking for a designer who builds. You will own product surfaces end to end: frame the problem, explore in whichever medium gets you to the truth fastest, prototype in code, and ship to production with engineers. There is no handoff file and no walking away after the mock is approved.

This is an individual contributor role. You will not manage people. Your influence comes from the work you ship and the bar you set for everyone around you.

**How we work**

Most work starts in a conversation with an engineer and a PM. It moves quickly into a working prototype, often built with Claude Code or Cursor on top of our real React components. We put it in front of customers, then refine it for system consistency and polish. Figma is where we think about systems and detail, not the only place design happens. You will help shape this process as the tools keep changing.

**What you'll work on**

* Agent experiences that earn trust: showing what Atom is doing and why, how sure it is, when it hands over to a person, and how to undo what it did.
* Dense, operational screens for IT teams (queues, request details, approvals, workflows) that stay calm and legible at scale.
* Our design system, in Figma and in code, with the frontend team.
* Prototypes wired to real models and real data, good enough to test with customers and to critique honestly.
* Pull requests to our frontend for polish, interactions and UI fixes, reviewed like any other engineering change.
* Quality after launch. You will use what you shipped, notice the paper cuts, and fix them.

**What we're looking for**

* Around 4–7 years designing software products, much of it in B2B SaaS. Years are a guide. What you have shipped matters more.
* Excellent visual and interaction craft. Type, hierarchy, spacing and motion, and the small details too: focus states, empty states, the words on a button.
* You build. You write solid HTML and CSS and can find your way around an existing frontend codebase. We build in React, so knowing it helps. If you don't, we expect you to pick it up from what you already know. You don't need to be a frontend engineer, but you should be able to ship UI polish yourself.
* AI is part of how you actually work. You use tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Claude Design to explore, prototype and build, and you can explain, test and take responsibility for what they produce. You also know where they fall short and when not to use them.
* Judgment over output. You can tell a generated screen from a solved problem, say what a prototype did not prove, and argue for killing a feature when it is the right call.
* A working understanding of how LLM products behave (latency, uncertainty, mistakes, non-deterministic output) and what that means for the interface.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and with opinionated teammates. You hold strong opinions loosely and change your mind when the evidence says so.
* You have read our values (agency, taste, ownership, mastery, impatience and customer obsession) and they sound like how you already work.

**Nice to have**

* You have built or contributed to a design system in code: tokens, components, documentation.
* You have designed conversational or agentic products, such as assistants in Slack or Teams, or copilots.
* Something you made on your own: a side project, an open-source component, a tool your team still uses.
* Experience with IT, HR or operations software.
* React experience.

**What we offer (compensation and benefits)**

We are big on benefits that make sense to you and your family.

1. **Fantastic team**
   — the #1 reason why people join us.
2. **Convenient offices**
   — well-located offices across five cities.
3. **Hybrid work**
   — four days working from the office, with Wednesdays working from home.
4. **Commute facilities**
   — cab available for the 8:30 AM–4:30 PM and 11 AM–7 PM shifts.
5. **Paid time off**
   — 31 days leave every year.
6. **Health insurance**
   — comprehensive health coverage for your entire family.
7. **Great hardware**
   — premium Apple hardware to help you do your best work.
8. **Flexible allowances**
   — hassle-free reimbursements across eligible expenses.
9. **Team events**
   — team meet-ups and celebrations for milestones.
10. **Annual outings**
    — a chance for everyone to have fun together.

**What next (applying for this role)**

1. Click on the apply button to get started with your application.
2. Answer a few questions about yourself and your work.
3. Wait to hear from us about the next steps.

***Important notice for candidates:***

*Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles at Atomicwork.*

* *Only apply through official Atomicwork channels. We do not use third-party agencies or individuals who ask for payments in exchange for interviews or offer letters.*
* *Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communication is being done through official Atomicwork email addresses. (@atomicwork)*
* *Atomicwork will never ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone asks you for money or financial details claiming to represent Atomicwork, please treat it as a scam and report it immediately.*

*By submitting your application, you confirm that all information provided by you is accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge. Any false or misleading information may result in disqualification from the hiring process or withdrawal of an offer. Your personal data will be processed in accordance with Atomicwork’s privacy and recruitment policies.*

title: Senior Designer
description:
Senior Designer

**Location:**
Bengaluru, in-person

**Team:**
Growth

We’re looking for a
**Senior Designer,**
someone who can move comfortably between Figma, user journeys, and product decisions.

This is not a role where design hands over screens and engineering builds them.

You’ll be expected to understand the problem, research the context, design the experience, build it, track how people use it and continuously improve it.

At LIT, you’ll work across both sides of the product:

* The
  **student/customer experience**
  — landing pages, application journeys, program discovery, lead funnels and digital touchpoints.
* The
  **internal LIT experience**
  — tools, workflows and systems used by admissions, marketing, program and operations teams.

**What you'll work on**

You’ll help build and scale LIT’s digital product ecosystem across the website, platform and internal tools.

Your work could include:

* Designing and building high-converting landing pages for new programs and campaigns.
* Understanding acquisition funnels and improving the journey from ad → website → enquiry → application → enrolment.
* Mapping complex user flows before jumping into UI.
* Improving information architecture, navigation and product usability.
* Building reusable frontend systems and components that allow LIT to launch faster as we scale.
* Creating internal tools that simplify how different LIT teams operate.
* Instrumenting products with analytics so we understand where users enter, drop off, convert and struggle.
* Running experiments across copy, interaction, page structure and user flows.
* Talking to students, leads and internal teams to understand what needs to be built.
* Translating qualitative research and quantitative data into product decisions.
* Working closely with marketing, admissions and program teams rather than operating as an isolated engineering function.

**You should be good at -**

**Design**

You understand that good UI is only one layer of good product design.

You should be comfortable with:

* UI design and visual hierarchy
* UX and interaction design
* User journey mapping
* Information architecture
* Responsive design
* Design systems
* Prototyping
* User research and interviews
* Context building before designing
* Turning ambiguous problems into clear product flows

A strong eye for typography, spacing, motion and visual detail matters.

**Product + Growth**

This role sits unusually close to growth.

You should understand — or be excited to learn — how digital products influence business outcomes.

That includes:

* Conversion funnels
* Landing page optimisation
* Lead generation
* Conversion rate optimisation
* A/B testing
* Event tracking
* Product analytics
* Funnel analysis
* Drop-off analysis
* Attribution basics
* Behavioural analytics

You should be able to ask questions like:

**Where are users dropping off?**

**What information are they looking for before they enquire?**

**Why is this page converting worse than another one?**

**Is the problem the interface, the copy, the traffic or the underlying journey?**

**You’ll probably enjoy this role if:**

* You care about design enough to notice when something is 4px off.
* You care about engineering enough to build things properly rather than just prototype them.
* You like figuring out
  *why*
  something should exist before deciding what it should look like.
* You can work with incomplete briefs and turn ambiguity into structure.
* You naturally think in systems rather than isolated screens.
* You’re comfortable speaking directly with users and internal teams.
* You’re curious about how design affects growth and business metrics.
* You like shipping quickly, measuring what happened and iterating.

We care much more about the quality of what you’ve built than the number of years you’ve worked.

**Within your first year, you should have helped LIT:**

* Build a faster and more scalable web ecosystem.
* Significantly improve key enquiry and application funnels.
* Create reusable systems for launching new programs and landing pages.
* Improve visibility into how users behave across LIT’s digital products.
* Reduce friction in internal workflows through better tools.
* Establish a stronger product/design system across LIT.
* Turn the website from a collection of pages into a continuously improving growth product.

**When applying, show us things you have actually built.**

We’d especially love to see projects where you:

* Designed and coded the product yourself.
* Improved an existing user journey.
* Built a landing page that had a measurable business outcome.
* Used research or analytics to change a product decision.
* Built an internal tool or workflow.
* Created a design system or reusable component architecture.

**Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!**
**About The Role**
Whatfix builds software that helps people work — guiding users through complex applications in real time, across web, mobile, and desktop. Our Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) powers how companies create, distribute, and manage in-app guidance at scale. As we go AI-native across the platform, the design problems are getting harder, more novel, and more interesting.
  
  
We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own design for a core area of the DAP product. This isn't a role for someone who needs a defined process to operate. It's a role for someone who can hold a clear vision for where the product is going, think through what matters next, and ship work that matters right now.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Product Design Across DAP**

* Own the end-to-end design of features across DAP's guidance creation, distribution, and management surfaces — web, mobile, and desktop.
* Lead your domain from discovery through delivery: research, ideation, prototyping, specification, and handoff.
* Define and maintain design quality within your product area — interaction models, usability standards, and consistency with the broader design system.
* Scrutinize requirements. Push back when what's being asked for isn't the right thing to build.

**AI-Native Design Work**

* Design for AI-powered features where patterns don't yet exist. That means inventing interaction models, not adapting existing ones.
* Use AI tools actively in your own workflow — building functional POCs in code, running rapid experiments, pushing early versions to understand lived experience before it's polished.
* Help define what AI-native UX means for digital adoption: for the customers building guidance, and for the end users receiving it.

**Research and Experimentation**

* Lead qualitative and quantitative research for your product area.
* Favor real-world experimentation over controlled environments. Get something working, get it in front of real users, and learn from how it actually behaves.
* Synthesize findings into clear direction and present them to cross-functional partners and leadership with confidence.

**Collaboration and Mentorship**

* Operate as a peer in planning and prioritization conversations — contributing to how problems are framed, not just how they're solved.
* Mentor the junior designer joining the team. Share knowledge, give direct feedback, raise the bar.
* Contribute to shared design standards and the evolution of design practices on the team.

**Required**
**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 4+ years of product design experience in SaaS or enterprise software. You're a Senior Designer — not a mid-level on the path to senior.
* A portfolio that demonstrates owning complex problem spaces end-to-end: research, design decisions, tradeoffs, and shipped work.
* Active use of AI tools in your design workflow — building POCs, using LLMs for synthesis, working across Figma and code. Not aspirational. Current practice.
* Strong interaction and UX design fundamentals — you know when to follow conventions and when to break them.
* Ability to work effectively in ambiguity, on problems that don't have established answers.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience designing for enterprise SaaS platforms, particularly tools used by non-technical users or content authors.
* Familiarity with digital adoption, in-app guidance, workflow automation, or onboarding experiences.
* Experience designing agent management, AI-generated, or AI-assisted outputs.

**How You'll Show Up**

* You design to solve problems now. You hold a vision for the future, build shared understanding for what's next, and ship in the present. Work stays connected to current OKRs, not some future state that keeps moving.
* You experiment to learn. A rough functional POC pushed to real users tells you more than weeks of structured testing. You're comfortable with that tradeoff.
* You're clear and direct. You can articulate what you're designing, why, and what you're trading off. You expect the same from the people around you.
* You're a peer, not an executor. You're in the room when problems are being framed, not just when solutions need to be drawn.
* You're already working at the edge of AI. You're not waiting for the tools to mature or the patterns to be established. You're building now, learning from what you ship, and helping define what AI-native design actually means in practice.

title: UI Designer – 0–1 Years Experience
description:
**About Enterprise Bot**

Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting-edge Conversational AI technology.

Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.

We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.

**What you will do**

We’re looking for a UI Designer with 0–1 years of experience who is excited about building beautiful, intuitive digital products and wants to grow in a fast-moving AI startup.

You don’t need years of experience. We’re looking for someone with a great eye for design, strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the willingness to experiment.

At Enterprise Bot, you’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and AI teams to turn ideas into polished product experiences — from early concepts and wireframes to high-fidelity designs and production-ready interfaces.

And yes — AI is a big part of how we work. We want someone who is excited to use AI tools to explore ideas, iterate faster, and find smarter ways of working.

****🎨 What You'll Do****

* Design clean, modern, and engaging web and SaaS interfaces.
* Turn product ideas and requirements into intuitive UI designs.
* Create wireframes, user flows, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
* Work primarily in Figma and create reusable components.
* Help build and maintain our design system.
* Work closely with Product Managers and Developers to take designs from idea → design → production.
* Collaborate with developers to make sure the final product matches the design.
* Think about responsive design across different screen sizes.
* Participate in design reviews, brainstorming, and product discussions.
* Explore different design approaches and iterate quickly based on feedback.
* Keep up with modern UI/UX trends and emerging design patterns.

****🤖 AI Is Part of the Job****

We’re an AI company, so we expect our designers to use AI, experiment with AI, and keep learning about AI.

You’ll be encouraged to use tools such as:

* ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini
* Figma AI
* AI-powered prototyping tools
* AI image and visual-generation tools
* AI-assisted research and ideation tools
* Other emerging AI tools that help you design faster and better

You don't need to know every AI tool today. What matters is that you're curious, comfortable experimenting, and excited to figure out how AI can improve your design workflow.

**What the role requires**

* 0–1 years of experience in UI/UX, product design, visual design, or a related field.
* Fresh graduates with strong portfolios are very welcome to apply.
* Good knowledge of Figma.
* Strong understanding of UI fundamentals — typography, colour, spacing, grids, hierarchy, and visual balance.
* A good eye for detail and visual consistency.
* Basic understanding of UX and user-centric design.
* Ability to take feedback and iterate quickly.
* Curiosity to learn new tools, technologies, and design trends.
* Interest in AI and AI-powered design workflows.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

****⭐ Bonus Points If You Have****

* Internship experience in UI/UX or Product Design.
* Experience designing SaaS or web applications.
* Experience with design systems and component libraries.
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS.
* Experience using AI tools for design, prototyping, research, or ideation.
* Personal projects or side projects that demonstrate your creativity.

****🎯 What Matters Most****

We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to use Figma.

We're looking for someone who can think, explore, experiment, and create.

If you have a strong portfolio, a good design eye, and you're excited about AI + Product Design, we'd love to hear from you.

Your portfolio matters more to us than the number of years on your CV.

**Your first months at Enterprise Bot**

You will have taken on core design tasks for our conversational AI platforms, shipped polished user interfaces for enterprise clients, and learned how GenAI technology integrates with popular software suites. Anyone who matches most of these requirements should still apply.

**Benefits**

* Work at a growing AI startup building real enterprise products.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and AI teams.
* Get hands-on experience with AI-first product design.
* Experiment with new AI and design tools.
* Have real ownership from day one.
* Learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Work on products used by customers across international markets.

If you're a designer who is just getting started and wants to build the future of AI products, this could be a great place to start. 🚀
