title: UI Architect
description:
Introduction
  
  
**Job Title:**
UI Architect
  
  
**Overview:**
SymphonyAI is at the forefront of innovation, leveraging cutting-edge artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to transform industries and drive business growth. As a global leader in AI-powered solutions, we empower organizations to harness the full potential of data-driven insights. SymphonyAI enterprise applications rapidly deliver transformative business value across retail, CPG, financial services, manufacturing, media, Enterprise IT (SymphonyAI Summit), and the public sector. SymphonyAI combines unrivalled AI technology, vertical expertise, and industry-specific data and insights into applications that drive the highest value for customers. We are one of the largest and fastest growing AI portfolios and are on a mission to build a "World Class Engineering Team" with a high-performance culture.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal UI Engineer to lead the design and delivery of high-quality, scalable web frontends. You will be hands-on, work across Angular and React, drive UI architecture and performance, and accelerate delivery using modern AI-assisted engineering tools. This is a senior individual contributor role with strong technical leadership expectations.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Responsibilities:**

* Own UI architecture: Define frontend architecture, patterns, and standards for large-scale Angular/React applications.
* Hands-on delivery: Build and ship complex features end-to-end (UI, state, routing, API integration, testing).
* Component systems: Develop and maintain reusable component libraries/design systems (PrimeNG and/or custom).
* Performance & quality: Improve Core Web Vitals, bundle size, rendering performance, accessibility, and reliability.
* Mentorship & technical leadership: Guide engineers through reviews, pairing, best practices, and incident learnings.
* AI-enabled engineering: Use AI tools to speed up coding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and documentation while maintaining strong engineering judgment.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product, Design, Backend, and QA to deliver cohesive experiences.
* Operational excellence: Champion observability (logging, metrics), release hygiene, and safe rollout strategies.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of frontend engineering experience with strong hands-on coding in production systems.
* Strong expertise in Angular (v14+)
* Solid experience with PrimeNG (or similar enterprise UI frameworks) and building reusable UI components.
* Strong knowledge of TypeScript, modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SCSS, and responsive design.
* Deep understanding of SPA architecture: routing, state management, API patterns, caching, error handling.
* Experience with state management (e.g., NGXS/NGRX/Redux/Zustand) and reactive patterns (RxJS).
* Strong engineering fundamentals: data structures, debugging, code reviews, maintainability.
* Proven ability to lead technical decisions and influence without authority.
* At least 1 year of deep usage experience in generating UI of higher quality using tools such as Cursor.
* Ability to estimate features and meet delivery timelines.

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications:**

* Experience with micro-frontends / Module Federation, monorepos (Nx), or shared UI libraries.
* Familiarity with charts/visualization (AMCharts, D3, etc.).
* Strong accessibility (WCAG) and i18n experience.
* Testing expertise: Jest/Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About Finkraft**

Finkraft.ai is an AI-first financial-automation company. We turn the messiest layer of enterprise travel and tax — invoices, entity identities and indirect-tax recovery — into clean, compliant, recoverable data for large corporates and their travel ecosystems. We’re building the product that powers VAT recovery and e-invoicing for hotels, travel-management companies and corporates across the UAE and GCC.

**Why this role exists**

*The onboarding and claim/VAT dashboard is the product’s first impression to hotels, TMCs and finance leaders — it has to feel like infrastructure, not a form.*

This is data-dense, trust-sensitive, workflow-heavy product design, and right now there is no design function shaping it. You’ll set the bar: design the experiences that make Finkraft feel inevitable, and stand up the system the rest of the product is built on.

**The shape of the role**

**Where you’ll be.**
Based in Bangalore with the build pod, designing for the UAE/GCC product. You’ll work close to the product and engineering teams and own design end to end — from research to handoff.

**What you’ll own — roles & responsibilities**

* **End-to-end UX.**
  Design the hotel onboarding flow and the claim / VAT-refund dashboard — the core surfaces hotels, TMCs and corporates live in.
* **Design system.**
  Stand up a design system (v0 and onward) so the product scales consistently as the build accelerates.
* **Prototyping & testing.**
  Ship clickable prototypes and run your own user testing with real hotels and TMCs — validate before the team builds.
* **Developer handoff.**
  Produce clean specs and partner closely with the product manager and engineers so what ships matches what you designed.
* **Data-dense clarity.**
  Turn complex tax, invoice and claim data into interfaces people trust and can act on at a glance.

Requirements
  
  

**The track record we’re looking for**

We’re looking for a designer who has shipped real, complex product — not a portfolio of mocks. Concretely:

* **Shipped B2B/fintech product.**
  6–10 years in product design with live, complex B2B, SaaS or fintech dashboards you can walk us through.
* **Data-density craft.**
  You can make twenty fields legible — you’ve designed dense workflows without clutter.
* **Research in your own hands.**
  You run your own user testing and can show how findings changed the design.
* **System thinking.**
  You’ve owned or built a design system, not just consumed one.

**Who you are**

**What we’re looking for**

**What great looks like**

**Shipped B2B / fintech design**

Live, complex product behind you — dashboards and workflows, not marketing pages.

**Data-dense dashboard craft**

You handle high information density with clarity and restraint.

**Prototyping & user testing**

Figma mastery; clickable prototypes; you test with real users and iterate.

**Design-system ownership**

You’ve built or owned a system that kept a product coherent as it scaled.

**Speed under constraints**

You balance polish against sprint reality and still ship.

**What gives you an edge**

* Fintech, tax or travel product experience.
* Light front-end literacy (you understand what’s cheap vs costly to build).
* Having built a design system from scratch.
* Comfort designing trust into a compliance or financial product.

Our teams work at the intersection of crypto, payments, trading and regulation, where security, reliability and user trust are non-negotiable. title: Lead Product Designer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

@DataWeave The Products team at DataWeave builds data products that deliver timely, actionable insights at scale. Our product suite includes Digital Shelf Analytics, Pricing Intelligence, Content Optimization, and SKU Management, along with internal tools that help the rest of the organization scale. Every one of these products asks users to make decisions from large volumes of data. Design is what determines whether they can.

We are hiring a Lead Product Designer to own end-to-end design at DataWeave. This spans two connected areas: the design of our product suite, and the design of everything that carries the DataWeave brand, including marketing content, white papers, and trade show materials. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will work directly with product managers, engineers, data scientists, marketing, and customers, and you will set the design standards the rest of the organization builds against.

Responsibilities:

Product design

• Own end-to-end design across the DataWeave product suite: discovery, user research, information architecture, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, interactive prototypes, and post-launch iteration.

• Design data-dense experiences that stay usable: dashboards, drill-downs, comparison views, alerting, and reporting workflows over billions of data points. Apply progressive disclosure and clear visual hierarchy so users find the insight without wading through the noise.

• Define and evolve our data visualization language: choose the right chart, table, or summary for each analytical question, and standardize these patterns across product modules.

• Design for multiple platforms and form factors: responsive web application, large-screen analyst workflows, mobile and tablet consumption views, and email/report exports, keeping the experience coherent across all of them.

• Establish and maintain the design system: a component library, interaction patterns, and accessibility standards (WCAG) that let multiple engineering teams ship consistent interfaces fast.

• Design the UX for AI-powered features: natural language querying, conversational workflows, AI-generated summaries and recommendations. Handle the hard parts of AI UX, including how to show confidence and provenance, how to let users verify and correct outputs, and how to design for responses that are sometimes wrong.

• Use modern AI tools as a core part of your own workflow, for generating design variations, building working prototypes, synthesizing research, producing marketing creatives, and accelerating handoff, while applying senior judgment to what these tools produce.

• Partner closely with engineering: deliver specs and prototypes precise enough to build from, review implementations, and make pragmatic trade-offs between design intent and delivery timelines.

• Use product analytics and user feedback to measure whether shipped designs work, and iterate when they do not.

• Present design rationale to leadership and customers clearly, and document design decisions so they survive team and roadmap changes.

Brand and marketing design

• Own the DataWeave brand identity across every surface it appears on: logo usage, typography, color, and visual language. Maintain brand guidelines and ensure everything the company puts out is consistent with them.

• Design marketing and thought-leadership content in partnership with the Marketing team: white papers, blog visuals and illustrations, case studies, sales decks, one-pagers, social media creatives, and website assets.

• Design DataWeave's presence at trade shows and industry events: booth design, banners, standees, brochures, giveaways, and other print collateral, including print-ready production files and coordination with vendors.

• Act as the design liaison to Marketing: plan design support for campaigns and events, manage competing deadlines across product and marketing work, and keep both sides informed of trade-offs.

You Have •

6-7+ years of UI/UX or product design experience on SaaS platforms, with a portfolio of shipped B2B products. Experience with data products, analytics tools, or dashboard-heavy interfaces is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience designing for multiple platforms: responsive web at minimum, with mobile, tablet, or other surfaces alongside it.

• A strong user research practice: you have personally planned and run interviews and usability tests with enterprise customers, not only consumed research done by others. • Working fluency with modern AI design tools and workflows (AI features in Figma or equivalent, prompt-to-prototype tools, AI-assisted research synthesis), and a point of view on where they help and where they mislead.

• Experience designing UX for AI or ML product features such as search, recommendations, conversational interfaces, or generated content, or clear evidence you can get there fast.

• Command of data visualization principles: when to use which chart form, how to design tables people can actually scan, and how to present uncertainty and data freshness honestly.

• Experience building or significantly extending a design system used by multiple teams.

• Visual and graphic design range beyond product UI: marketing collateral, long-form content layout (white papers, reports), and print. Working knowledge of print production, including bleed, resolution, and color profiles, and of tools such as Adobe Creative Suite alongside Figma.

• Experience owning or stewarding a company's brand identity, and the judgment to apply it consistently across product, web, content, and physical materials.

• Experience working with marketing teams on campaigns, events, or content, and the ability to balance marketing deadlines against product roadmap work without letting either slip silently.

• Enough technical understanding to collaborate well with engineers: how web front ends are built, what is cheap and what is expensive to implement, and how APIs and data pipelines constrain what the interface can show.

• Excellent communication skills. You can defend a design decision with evidence, write clear documentation, and present to customers and executives.

• Comfort operating with high ownership in a fast-paced, startup-like environment: you drive your own work, unblock yourself, and raise standards for everyone around you.

Growth @ DataWeave

• Fast-track growth opportunities at dynamically evolving start-ups.

• Work on a variety of challenging data/design/user problems. Make a real impact.

• A culture of innovation and continuous learning.

• Learning opportunities with courses and product conferences.

How we Work

For us, it's hard to tell what we love more – problems or solutions! Every day, we tackle some of the hardest data, design, and user experience problems out there. We are in the business of making sense of messy public data on the Web, at serious scale!

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
**About The Company**
Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory & transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise .
  
  
**Job Summary**
Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products — often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.
  
  
We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built.
  
  
**How This Role Operates**
You'll partner with Product and Engineering early — shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.
  
  
Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post-launch iteration
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements
* Translate in-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns
* Define the interaction models for AI-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it
* Evolve and maintain Consilio's design system — defining components and patterns, and setting the standards for how they're used
* Build accessibility standards into the system rather than retrofitting it
* Prototype rapidly to explore, align, and de-risk decisions using modern AI tools
* Lead or partner on user research, and turn findings into decisions other people can act on
* Make the case for design decisions and system standards to senior stakeholders through evidence and clear storytelling

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years designing complex enterprise or B2B software, with shipped work you can walk us through
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a multi-product environment — not just consuming one
* Experience designing end-to-end journeys for multi product ecosystems
* Experience with Figma Make, or other similar prompt-based prototyping tools.
* Depth in interaction design, with visual craft strong enough to make the work persuasive
* Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering from problem definition forward
* Bachelor’s degree in Design (e.g., Interaction, Visual, Industrial Design), HCI, or equivalent practical experience.

**Qualities we're looking for**

* Systems thinking. You design for scale and consistency by default, not as a cleanup pass.
* Standards judgment. You know when to generalize a pattern and when a one-off is the right answer — and you can say no to a component request without damaging the relationship.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You can make a defensible tradeoff without perfect information, and revisit it when better information arrives.
* Influence without authority. You change what gets built by being persuasive and well-reasoned, not by escalating.
* Clarity under complexity. You can take a genuinely complicated workflow and make it feel obvious.

**Portfolio**

* Strong portfolio demonstrating complex workflow design across multiple web-based enterprise products.
* Work samples that showcase prototyping ability.

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with AI driven products or designing AI powered interactions
* Formal or self-directed learning in AI/ML concepts
* Prior experience designing for legal, compliance, healthcare, financial services, or another high-consequence regulated domain.

**Why Join Us:**

* Be part of a collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Opportunity for professional growth and development.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Contribute to shaping the future of our software development processes.

**Consilio’s True North Values**

* Client Experience | Listen for the “why ”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
* Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography , generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
* Innovation | Always be curious (ABC ). Challenge the status quo . Experiment and fail forward . Build for the future.
* Grit | Focus on what matters . Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner . Deliver results you’re proud of.

**Consilio, LLC is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.**

title: Product Designer
description:
**Who this is for** 




 You're two\-plus years into a design career and your default is to build, not present when you have an idea, you open Figma, Make, or a notebook before you write a spec. You haven't necessarily shipped an AI\-native product to real users, and that's fine. What matters is that AI tools are already part of how you design, not a novelty you're bolting on.
 



 You'll join a team rebuilding what "product design" means at Jupiter, where agents are part of the interface, not just screens. You won't set that direction you'll learn it fast, apply it daily, and earn more of it over time.
 



  





**The context** 




 Jupiter is a neobank spanning savings, payments, cards, loans, investments, and insurance, operating through RBI\-regulated partner banks. AI is core infrastructure here, not a bolt\-on: production agents already run parts of the business, and customer\-facing agentic experiences are next, starting with customer servicing.
 



 At your level, this shows up two ways: designing conventional flows (onboarding, repayment, activation) to a high craft bar, and contributing to agentic surfaces turning a senior designer's specs into real states (loading, streaming, error, escalation), using AI tools to move fast through variants, copy drafts, and edge\-case audits.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



* Own execution on a defined slice, not a whole surface. You'll get a specific flow or feature rather than an entire funnel. A senior designer owns the strategy and the metric you own the craft and the detail, and you execute it yourself. Within your slice, the layout, copy, edge\-case handling, and interaction detail are your calls to make, not sign\-off requests; what's fixed is the overall behavior definition and the metric, not how it gets built.
* Turn product requirements/specs into real screens. Working closely with the Product team to execute functions, own end\-to\-end UX and UI
* Use AI tools as your default workflow, not a special case. First\-pass explorations, layout variants, copy options, basic accessibility checks generate these with AI so your own time goes into judgment calls: what reads well, what feels trustworthy, what's confusing. We'll ask you to show this workflow, not just describe it.
* Prototype before you hand off. Every design ships as a working prototype, even a rough one, before an engineer starts building. Static frames alone aren't done work here.
* Sit in on trust\-and\-safety design, learn the stakes. You won't independently own a consent or money\-movement screen yet those get senior review by default, since the cost of a mistake is real financial harm but you'll work closely on them, and it's one of the fastest paths to more ownership.



  





**How you'll grow here** 




 This role builds two muscles at once: classic execution craft (funnels, comprehension, polish) and fluency with agentic design (non\-deterministic states, conversation design, tool\-use visibility). Designers who do well here get a full surface to own within their first year, and a say in the AI interaction system within two.
 



  





**What we're not expecting from you on day one** 




 A track record of shipped AI products used by real customers. A point of view on Jupiter's whole agent design language. The ability to independently defend a metric move in front of leadership you'll do that alongside someone senior first.
 



  





**How we'll interview you** 



* Show us something you built not necessarily AI\-native or shipped, a personal project, hackathon, or old prototype. We want to see that you build, not just spec.
* Walk us through one design decision you'd change. Pick a past project and tell us what you'd do differently now we're listening for self\-awareness, not a clean success story.
* Show us your AI tool habits. What you actually use day to day for exploration, drafting, or QA, and why you picked those over alternatives.
* A short paired exercise. We'll hand you a rough flow (classic or agentic) and ask you to take it further live, with whatever tools you'd normally reach for. We're watching how you think, not judging pixel polish.



  





**Logistics** 




 Bangalore, in person. 2\+ years of experience in product design, consumer or fintech. Reports to a senior designer or design lead.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About AiDASH**
 AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.
   

  

 The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\.
   

  

 Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Senior Product Designer at AiDASH, you will define the standard for AI\-augmented design practice across the organization. You are not just a designer who occasionally uses AI—you are someone who has fundamentally rewired your design workflow around AI tools, using them daily for research synthesis, rapid prototyping, visual exploration, and production\-ready output.
   

  

 You bring extensive experience in user experience design with deep specialisation in at least three areas: user research, service design, digital product design, interface design, visual design, or related disciplines. Crucially, you also bring a proven track record of leveraging AI tools to dramatically accelerate and elevate your design work.
   

  

**How You'll Make an Impact:**
* Drive Technology Transformation: Play a key role in delivering and designing technology solutions that reshape how our clients operate. Use AI tools (e.g., Galileo AI, Uizard, Relume, v0, or similar) to go from concept to interactive prototype in hours, not days—dramatically accelerating ideation\-to\-delivery timelines.
* Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with cross\-functional teams to produce design deliverables—journey maps, service blueprints, roadmaps, prototypes, and design systems.
* Apply Research with Precision: Use diverse research methods—context analysis, moderated interviews, experiments, and user testing. Augment these with AI to transcribe interviews, cluster findings, extract patterns from qualitative data, and accelerate insight generation and communication.
* Create Production\-Ready Designs with AI: Use generative AI for mood boards, visual explorations, icon generation, illustration, and design variations at scale. Craft effective prompts to get high\-quality outputs from AI design and image\-generation tools, then iterate and refine AI\-generated assets to production quality.
* Build and Scale AI\-Augmented Design Systems: Use AI to help maintain, scale, and enforce consistency across design system components and documentation. Identify and implement AI\-powered automations to eliminate repetitive tasks (e.g., auto\-generating responsive variants, batch\-resizing assets, content population).
* Champion AI Adoption in Design: Evangelise and mentor the broader design and product team on integrating AI tools into their workflows. Establish best practices, standards, and playbooks for AI\-assisted design across the organisation.
* Manage Scope, Risks, and Progress: Proactively monitor project scope, risks, and updates, ensuring clear communication and alignment across stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.


**What We're Looking For:**
* Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4\+ years of experience in UX/product design with a strong portfolio showcasing design principles applied to web and/or mobile platforms
* Demonstrated, hands\-on proficiency with AI design tools—must be able to show examples of AI\-assisted work in your portfolio (e.g., AI\-generated prototypes, AI\-enhanced visuals, AI\-driven research synthesis)
* Proficiency with core design tools: Figma (required), plus experience with at least two AI\-powered design or prototyping tools
* Strong understanding of when to use AI and when human craft is essential—you know AI's strengths and limitations in a design context


**Nice to have:**
* Experience with AI prototyping tools such as Galileo AI, Uizard, Relume, v0 by Vercel, Framer AI, or Figma AI features
* Familiarity with generative image tools (Midjourney, DALL\-E, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly) for design exploration and asset creation
* A highly creative mindset with the ability to translate ideas into polished, functional, and visually compelling prototypes—with or without AI assistance
* Proven success collaborating across organizational boundaries and working effectively with cross\-functional teams in fast\-paced startup environments
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to craft and deliver engaging presentations
* Passion for climate tech, sustainability, or infrastructure modernisation


**PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS**
 Your portfolio should include at least two case studies that explicitly demonstrate your use of AI tools in the design process. We want to see:
   

  

* Before/after examples showing how AI accelerated or improved your workflow
* Your process for integrating AI—what tools you used, how you prompted them, and how you refined the outputs
* Clear articulation of where AI added value vs. where your human judgment and craft were essential


*We're not looking for perfection in AI output—we're looking for a designer who knows how to wield AI strategically and isn't afraid to show the messy, iterative process.*
 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.
   

  

 Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy\-policy/

 About the job Visual Designer Own the visual identity of a fast\-growing, Accel\-backed AI startup Fibr AI \| HSR Layout, Bangalore \| Full\-Time \| In\-office About the Role Got an eye for design and a love for making complex things look effortless? This is your shot to own the entire visual language of Fibr.ai, across marketing, brand, product storytelling, and social. Your work will directly shape how a fast\-growing AI startup shows up to the world. You'll work hand in hand with founders and the marketing team, turning bold ideas into visuals that are modern, memorable, and impossible to scroll past. What Working With Us Looks Like Your work won't just live inside Fibr's own brand. You'll often get to shape how other respected businesses present themselves visually, including reimagining their web presence end to end. That's a level of trust and credibility not every design role offers this early in a career. You'll work directly with founders and the marketing team, with real access to decision makers, fast feedback loops, and the chance to shape brand direction early on, not just execute a brief. You'll work across a rich mix of formats, from product explainers to campaign content to decks, and get to enjoy real variety in what you design day to day. You take creative briefs and run with them, bringing your own point of view while staying aligned with brand direction. You're a proactive problem solver, someone who spots what needs attention and acts on it rather than waiting to be asked. Great design here is a craft we shape together. You'll collaborate closely with the team to refine ideas until they truly land. As an early stage team, roles flex a bit. One week might be pure visual design, another might involve jumping in on a campaign asset. We love people who enjoy that kind of variety. We're building something long term, and we're looking for someone excited to grow with the company and the mission. Your Work Will Include (a.k.a. What You'll Get To Create) Designing marketing graphics, campaign assets, website visuals, and product explainers Creating social content, email graphics, ads, landing page assets, and presentation decks Producing UI inspired visuals that bring our product story alive Contributing to brand evolution, visual identity, and creative direction (Preferred) Creating short motion graphics, animations, and micro interactions Collaborating with product teams to maintain a cohesive design system Brainstorming creative concepts for launches, campaigns, and events Culture \& Values Founder close, low bureaucracy: We're a small, AI native team of about 30 people. You'll have direct visibility into decisions and direction, not layers of sign off. Ownership over instructions: We value people who take a problem and run with it, not just execute tasks. Craft over speed alone: We care about getting things right. Design here is refined collaboratively, not rushed and forgotten. We celebrate the people, not just the output We build community, not just a workplace: in office meals, pantry snacks, and monthly turf sports evenings help the team stay connected outside of pure work. AI first mindset: we expect and encourage the use of AI tools across design, content, and workflows. This is core to how we operate, not an afterthought. Long term builders wanted: we're looking for people who want to grow with the company's mission, not just a role or a single manager. What We're Looking For Must have skills: About 2 years of experience as a visual designer, graphic designer, or brand designer Strong design fundamentals: layout, typography, color, composition Proficiency with Illustrator, Canva, and Figma Ability to think visually and translate product concepts into clean, modern graphics (bonus if you also know Framer) A self starter mindset, comfortable taking a brief and running with it, and equally comfortable asking for direction when needed Enjoys collaborating closely with the team to shape and refine ideas until they land well Creativity, attention to detail, and a product focused design mindset Ability to deliver high quality work across multiple formats (web, social, presentations) Comfortable working with AI tools for design (Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, etc.) Experience with AI image generation, prompt crafting, and AI assisted creative workflows Strong work ethic and reliability, someone the team can count on Portfolio and resume required; a portfolio of past work is highly preferred Preferred but not mandatory: Motion graphics or animation experience (After Effects, Premiere, or similar) Hands on experience with Framer (big plus), or familiarity with Webflow and website design principles Experience designing for SaaS, AI, or tech products Prior startup or fast paced environment experience Skills Graphic Design, Design, Visual Design, UI/UX Design, Brand Design \& Strategy

title: Product Management and Software Engineering Intern
description:
**Sapiensu is hiring a product management and engineering intern.** 




  





 Sapiensu reads the public record on a company or an individual. It returns findings a deal team can act on, and still defend six months later in front of an investment committee, a lender or a regulator.
 



  





 Learn more at www.sapiensu.com
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 One person doing two jobs.
 



  





 You will write and ship code in the product. You will also work on the product itself: sitting in customer conversations, reading back what was said, and helping decide what gets built next.
 



  





 This is not a shadowing role. The product is built and in use by external testers.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WOULD BE WORKING ON** 




  





 Engineering
 



  




* Building and shipping features in the web app, in React and TypeScript.
* Working on how each finding carries its evidence: the source behind it, how reliable that source is, and when it was found.
* Backend and data work, including the model API calls that turn sources into findings. Every output has to trace back to a source. If it cannot, it does not ship.



  





 Product
 



  




* Customer development with a waitlist who signed up before there was a product to show them. Part of the job is working out which of them we should build for.
* Sitting in user conversations and turning what you hear into decisions about what we build next.



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




  




* Evidence that you have built something and finished it. A side project, a tool, a repository. It does not have to be polished and it does not have to be in our domain.
* Genuine curiosity about why people behave as they do, and the willingness to change your mind when a user contradicts you.
* Comfort in a very small team with no structured onboarding and no training programme.
* Interest in why a finding has to survive being challenged six months after it is written.



  





 You do not need prior experience in finance, law or diligence.
 



  





**WHAT YOU NEED** 




  




* Comfort with React and TypeScript.
* Working knowledge of at least one of Python, Rust or Go.
* Some exposure to backend work, data work or LLM APIs.



  





**TERMS** 




  




* Three months, full\-time, in person in Bengaluru.
* Stipend commensurate with experience and qualifications.
* Starting as soon as possible.



  





 If you perform well, there is a real possibility of a full\-time role at the end of the internship. We would rather state it that way than promise something we cannot guarantee in advance.
 



  





**TO APPLY** 




  





 Email parita@sapiensu.com with:
 


* your resume
* a link to something you have built
* one paragraph on why you want to work on this (write it yourself. Do not use AI).

title: Sr. SW Engineer - UI

 MantaRay NM is a cutting\-edge network management platform that empowers telecommunications providers to efficiently operate, optimize, and assure their complex network infrastructures. It offers advanced automation, analytics, and fault management capabilities, crucial for delivering high\-performance and reliable services in today's dynamic digital landscape.
   

  

 As a UI Senior Software Engineer, you will independently deliver robust UI features, focusing on architecture, performance, and secure coding within a cloud\-native environment. This role involves integrating UI components with Java services, REST APIs, and microservices, while owning UI test automation and CI/CD pipelines using tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. You will also utilize Agentic AI in your development workflow, coach junior engineers, and contribute to a team dedicated to cutting\-edge web technologies including JavaScript, React, and Node.js.

description:
**Role Description**
 Job Description\- Senior Front\-End \& API Developer (T3\)
   

  

* Senior Full Stack Java Front End developer Github Copilot \+ Python expertise is mandatory .We are seeking a Senior Front\-End \& API Developer with strong expertise in modern web application development and practical backend API engineering. This role will design and build responsive user experiences, reusable components, integration APIs, and lightweight orchestration services that connect enterprise systems, execute approved pipelines and automation tasks, integrate AI agents, and present data from multiple sources. The role requires hands\-on engineering, secure design, architectural thinking, and close collaboration with product, backend, platform, and security teams. Key Responsibilities: Front\-End Software Development
* Design, develop, test, and maintain secure, responsive, and modular web applications using modern JavaScript and TypeScript frameworks.
* Build reusable components, shared user\-interface patterns, workflow\-driven forms, dashboards, status views, and task\-execution experiences.
* Translate business and operational requirements into intuitive user journeys with clear validation, progress, error, approval, and recovery states.
* Implement accessibility, responsive design, and cross\-browser compatibility in line with enterprise standards.
* Optimize client\-side performance using effective state management, caching, code splitting, telemetry, and continuous performance measurement. API Development \& Enterprise Integration
* Design and build secure RESTful APIs and backend\-for\-frontend services using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
* Create controlled API wrappers and orchestration endpoints that invoke approved CI/CD pipelines, automation jobs, runbooks, and long\-running tasks.
* Integrate web applications with enterprise data sources, cloud services, identity platforms, ticketing systems, automation tools, and internal APIs.
* Implement asynchronous execution patterns, callbacks, polling, webhooks, and real\-time status updates for long\-running processes.
* Define and maintain OpenAPI specifications, versioning, validation, error contracts, idempotency behavior, and integration documentation.
* Collaborate with backend engineers on service boundaries, API contracts, data models, security controls, and integration patterns. AI, Generative AI \& Agent Integration
* Integrate enterprise\-approved AI agents and copilots into web applications, guided workflows, decision\-support capabilities, and task\-execution experiences.
* Build secure interfaces and API adapters for agent tool calling, streamed responses, citations, user feedback, escalation, and human approval checkpoints.
* Apply permission\-aware context, data protection, prompt\-injection defenses, and user confirmation before impactful AI\-assisted actions.
* Instrument AI interactions for quality evaluation, latency, cost, traceability, and user feedback without exposing confidential data. Security, Quality \& Reliability
* Implement enterprise authentication and authorization using SSO, OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, role\-based access control, and permission\-aware experiences.
* Protect web applications and APIs against cross\-site scripting, request forgery, injection, insecure dependencies, and secrets exposure.
* Build unit, component, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end automated tests with meaningful quality gates.
* Implement structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, client telemetry, and actionable error handling across browser and API components.
* Participate in code reviews, threat modeling, design reviews, production support, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement. DevOps \& Agile Delivery
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for web applications and APIs using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent tooling.
* Package and deploy solutions using cloud\-native services, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code in collaboration with platform engineers.
* Break requirements into user stories and technical tasks with clear acceptance criteria, estimates, test coverage, and operational readiness expectations.
* Actively participate in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement with cross\-functional teams. Required Technical Skills \& Tools: Front\-End Engineering
* Advanced proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with strong experience in React; experience with Next.js, Angular, or an equivalent framework is valuable.
* Strong understanding of component architecture, state management, routing, form handling, data visualization, responsive design, and design systems.
* Experience with accessible web development, preferably aligned with WCAG 2\.1 AA or later guidance.
* Hands\-on experience with front\-end testing tools such as Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Working knowledge of browser performance profiling, web security, and client\-side observability. API \& Integration Engineering
* Strong hands\-on experience with Python and an API framework such as FastAPI, Django REST Framework, or Flask.
* Strong knowledge of REST, JSON, OpenAPI, authentication, authorization, pagination, rate limiting, caching, API gateways, and secure API design.
* Experience integrating asynchronous and event\-driven services using queues, events, webhooks, background workers, or serverless functions.
* Experience consuming, validating, and normalizing data from multiple APIs and presenting stable contracts to web applications. Cloud, AI \& Engineering Platforms
* Hands\-on development experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS services for application hosting, API management, serverless execution, messaging, identity, monitoring, and secrets management.
* Experience integrating LLM\- or agent\-based services through secure APIs, tool/function calling, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) is preferred.
* Working knowledge of containers, Git, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, dependency management, and software supply\-chain security.
* Hands\-on use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot for development, refactoring, testing, and documentation, with rigorous review of generated code. Relationships and engagement: Builds strong engagement with internal teams and stakeholders by leading technical discussions, clarifying requirements and dependencies, managing incidents and escalations, and driving problem resolution. Actively contributes to knowledge sharing, lessons learned, engineering standards, and continuous improvement through stakeholder feedback. Job Qualifications \& Experience Education:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered. Experience
* More than 05 years of software development experience, including substantial delivery of modern enterprise web applications.
* Demonstrated experience building both front\-end applications and production APIs or backend\-for\-frontend services.
* Experience delivering authenticated, role\-based workflows and integrations in a cloud\-hosted enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting production applications through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and iterative improvement.
* Experience integrating automation pipelines, AI\-enabled capabilities, or task\-execution workflows is strongly preferred. Other Knowledge, Skills, Abilities or Certifications:
* Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, AWS Developer, or an equivalent cloud developer certification will be preferred.
* Relevant secure\-development, accessibility, React/TypeScript, Python, or AI engineering certification.

title: Director User Exp Design
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
 Honeywell User Experience (HUE) design studios lead the creation of next\-generation experiences for the connected world. Leveraging well\-established human\-centered design principles, HUE ensures that Honeywell products and applications are the most useful, usable, and desirable in the marketplace. The studios operate globally across North America, Europe, China, and Australia, fostering a collegial,
   

  

****ROLE OVERVIEW****
 The PA HUE Leader at HTCS is a senior design executive responsible for two interconnected capabilities: (1\) leading the HUE Design Studio for the Process Automation (PA) business, driving the UX vision, strategy, and delivery aligned with the PA SBG and GBE leadership; and (2\) overseeing the Technical Writer team, ensuring that product knowledge is translated into accurate, user\-centered documentation that enhances the overall customer experience.
   

  

 This dual mandate positions the PA HUE Leader as a key steward of both visual\-interactive experience design and content\-driven experience design — recognizing that great products must be equally well\-designed and well\-documented.
   

  

****RESPONSIBILITIES****
**SCOPE OF LEADERSHIP**
* HUE Design Studio — Process Automation


 Lead a Growing, Multidisciplinary Team Of User Experience Designers Delivering Next\-generation, Delightful Solutions Across The PA Product Portfolio. Key Responsibilities Include:
   

  

* Developing design capability and infrastructure aligned with PA business strategy.
* Recruiting, developing, and managing UX design talent; managing resources and operational plans.
* Overseeing multidisciplinary competencies: design research, experience design, interaction design, visual design, and industrial design.
* Driving 2–3 high\-impact, innovative offerings based on a UX\-led approach.
* Delivering design projects on time to support business growth and enhance product value.
* Collaborating with PA Global Experience Design teams to implement a design strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
* Contributing to HUE best practices for User Experience Design throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Participating as a decision\-maker at project reviews; providing a clear, consistent UX perspective to teams and stakeholders.
* Creating and executing human\-centered designs that differentiate Honeywell brands globally.
* Applying, building, and evolving the Honeywell Design Language System (DLS) and brand identity program.
* Contributing to management updates, operational reviews, and leadership dialogue at HUE Global Leadership and HTS India Leadership.
* Collaborating with all Honeywell functions that interact with customers to deliver end\-to\-end journey alignment.
* Establishing a framework for regular usability testing with dedicated UX researchers embedded across studios.
* Overseeing co\-creation workshops with end users to inform new product and service development.
* Identifying opportunities to improve data visualization and interpretability through design.
* Promoting a holistic, end\-to\-end user experience strategy across all product touchpoints.
* Championing system thinking and storytelling techniques to align product vision with user needs.
* Technical Writer Team — Documentation \& Content Experience


 Provide Leadership And Strategic Direction To The Technical Writer Team, Ensuring Product Documentation Is Accurate, Structured, And User\-centered. This Team Is Integral To The Customer Experience And Works At The Intersection Of Product Knowledge And Communication Design. Key Responsibilities Include:
   

  

* Overseeing end\-to\-end documentation for products and programs, covering user guides, installation manuals, administrator guides, and troubleshooting references.
* Directing the development of feature walkthroughs, process flow documentation, and security white papers.
* Ensuring the team effectively uses MadCap Flare to produce high\-quality HTML and PDF documentation.
* Guiding the creation of HTML\-based user assistant files that enhance in\-product guidance.
* Building and managing a structured review and feedback cycle with key stakeholders — developers, testing teams, program managers, installation teams, and security teams.
* Embedding technical writing quality standards focused on content accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
* Aligning documentation strategy with the broader UX and product experience roadmap, ensuring parity between product design intent and user\-facing documentation.
* Fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the technical writing function, including upskilling in structured authoring and content design principles.


****QUALIFICATIONS****
**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**
**Education**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) from an institute of repute in Design, Human Factors, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.
   

  

****Experience****
* 12 or more years of experience in User Experience design of products and software applications.
* Demonstrated experience in a senior design leadership role, managing multidisciplinary teams including UX designers, researchers, and/or technical writers.
* Experience working in Agile environments with lean UX methodologies.
* International experience working with regional businesses and geographically distributed design teams.
* Proven track record of delivering innovative, market\-released UX design solutions; portfolio required.
* Experience directing and managing external design and development firms.
* Exposure to or direct experience overseeing technical documentation functions is an advantage.


****Design \& Technical Skills****
* Proficiency in UX design tools: Figma, prototyping platforms, interaction and visual design toolsets.
* Deep understanding of Design Language Systems and brand identity programs.
* Ability to create low\-fidelity to high\-fidelity prototypes across the design lifecycle.
* Demonstrated research skills across qualitative and quantitative methods.
* Familiarity with technical documentation platforms (e.g., MadCap Flare, HTML/PDF publishing pipelines) is desirable.
* Understanding of structured content principles, single\-source publishing, and content strategy.


****Leadership \& Soft Skills****
* Ability to translate complex vision into understandable concepts and workable design narratives.
* Strong ability to influence product, software, hardware, and development teams during early\-stage development.


****ABOUT US****
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Assistant Manager/Manager - Qualitative Research
description:
**Associate Manager / Manager – Qualitative Research (Individual Contributor)**
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Consumer\-Centric Finance**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian by building products that are secure, intuitive, and trusted.
   

  

 As crypto evolves from an early\-adopter category to a mainstream financial product, understanding people has become just as important as building technology. Every feature we launch, every campaign we create, and every customer experience we design has the potential to influence how millions of Indians engage with digital assets.
   

  

 Our Consumer Insights team sits at the intersection of Product, Design, Marketing, Strategy, Analytics, and the Founder's Office. We help the organisation move beyond knowing what customers do to understanding why they do it—bringing the voice of the customer into every important business decision.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of that mission, uncovering deep human insights that shape product innovation, customer growth, and brand strategy.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a curious, empathetic, and business\-minded Qualitative Researcher to join our central Consumer Insights team.
   

  

 You will be responsible for leading end\-to\-end qualitative research initiatives that help the organisation deeply understand customers, uncover unmet needs, validate product opportunities, and influence strategic decisions across the business.
   

  

 This role is critical to building customer empathy across:
   

  

* Product discovery and innovation
* User experience and journey optimisation
* Brand positioning and communication
* Customer acquisition and retention strategy
* Market and behavioural understanding
* You will work closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Strategy, Analytics, and the Founder's Office to ensure customer understanding remains central to every important decision


**Why This Role Exists**
* Analytics can tell us what customers are doing.
* Qualitative research helps us understand why.
* As CoinDCX continues to scale its products, customer base, and business complexity, there is a growing need for researchers who can uncover motivations, anxieties, unmet needs, and behavioural patterns that cannot be observed through data alone.
* There is a critical need for someone who can:
* Discover unmet customer needs before they become obvious to the market.
* Help Product and Design teams build experiences customers genuinely value.
* Build empathy across the organisation by bringing authentic customer voices into business conversations.
* Translate qualitative observations into strategic recommendations that influence decisions.
* Establish research as a strategic capability rather than a validation function.
* This role ensures that customer understanding becomes a competitive advantage for CoinDCX as we build the future of investing and digital finance.


**What You'll Do**
**Customer Discovery \& Qualitative Research**
* Lead end\-to\-end qualitative research projects from business problem definition to strategic recommendations.
* Design and execute research across customer, product, and brand domains.
* Conduct:
* In\-depth Interviews (IDIs)
* Focus Group Discussions (FGDs)
* Customer Immersions
* Ethnographic Research
* Diary Studies
* Contextual Inquiry
* Exploratory Research
* Usability Studies
* UX Research
* Identify customer motivations, barriers, aspirations, unmet needs, and behavioural patterns that influence business decisions.


**Product Discovery \& Innovation**
 Partner with Product and Design teams to identify opportunities for new products and improved customer experiences.
   

  

 Conduct early\-stage discovery research, concept testing, and proposition evaluation.
   

  

 Support product roadmap decisions through deep customer understanding.
   

  

 Identify whitespace opportunities and emerging customer needs.
   

  

**Insight Generation \& Storytelling**
 Analyse qualitative data to uncover meaningful patterns and strategic insights.
   

  

 Translate customer conversations into compelling narratives that influence business decisions.
   

  

 Develop research reports, frameworks, personas, customer journeys, and opportunity maps.
   

  

 Present findings to senior leadership through engaging storytelling.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
 Partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Strategy, Analytics, and Business teams.
   

  

 Help stakeholders frame research questions and identify the right research approach.
   

  

 Collaborate with Quantitative Research and Analytics teams on mixed\-method studies where required.
   

  

 Champion customer empathy across the organisation.
   

  

**Research Operations \& Capability Building**
 Contribute to establishing scalable qualitative research practices and knowledge repositories.
   

  

 Leverage AI tools to improve research efficiency across interview synthesis, thematic analysis, reporting, and insight generation.
   

  

 Support the development of repeatable research frameworks and best practices.
   

  

**You'll Excel in This Role If You Have**
**Core Requirements**
 3–5 years of experience in qualitative research.
   

  

 Experience working with leading research agencies such as Kantar, Ipsos, NielsenIQ, Human8, Quantum, FSG, or similar research and consulting firms.
   

  

 Agency\-only experience is absolutely acceptable.
   

  

 Experience independently leading qualitative research studies.
   

  

 Strong moderation skills across IDIs, FGDs, customer immersions, and exploratory research.
   

  

 Exceptional qualitative analysis and synthesis capabilities.
   

  

 Excellent storytelling and presentation skills.
   

  

 Ability to identify patterns across customer narratives and translate them into actionable business recommendations.
   

  

 Experience managing multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously.
   

  

 Ability to thrive in ambiguity and solve complex business problems.
   

  

**Preferred**
 Experience in fintech, investing, trading, crypto, or adjacent consumer technology categories.
   

  

 Exposure to UX research and product discovery methodologies.
   

  

 Familiarity with quantitative research fundamentals and mixed\-method research.
   

  

 Experience using AI tools to accelerate research planning, analysis, synthesis, reporting, and insight generation.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 Deep Customer Empathy
   

  

 Exceptional Moderation \& Interviewing Skills
   

  

 Behavioural Analysis \& Pattern Recognition
   

  

 Strategic Storytelling \& Insight Synthesis
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

 Product Discovery \& Innovation Mindset
   

  

 AI\-Enabled Research Workflows
   

  

 Ownership \& Business Curiosity
   

  

**You'll Know You're Winning When**
 Product, Design, and Marketing teams proactively seek research before making key decisions.
   

  

 Customer interviews consistently uncover actionable opportunities for product and business improvement.
   

  

 Research findings influence product roadmaps, customer experience improvements, and growth initiatives.
   

  

 Stakeholders reference customer insights during planning and decision\-making discussions.
   

  

 Research outputs become faster, richer, and more scalable through effective use of AI.
   

  

 Customer empathy becomes embedded across teams rather than existing only within the research function.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 A mature qualitative research practice that is trusted across the organisation.
   

  

 Customer insights directly influence product strategy, design decisions, and brand initiatives.
   

  

 Product teams develop experiences grounded in genuine customer needs rather than assumptions.
   

  

 Research becomes a strategic input into business planning rather than a post\-decision validation exercise.
   

  

 The voice of the customer becomes embedded across Product, Design, Marketing, Strategy, and Leadership decision\-making.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
 Here's what your interview journey with CoinDCX looks like:
   

  

 Application Review
   

  

 Recruiter Connect
   

  

 Portfolio Round
   

  

 Research Case Study \& Discussion
   

  

 Hiring Manager Round
   

  

 Culture \& Values Discussion
   

  

**Ready to Help Build the Future of Customer\-Centric Finance?**
 If you're passionate about understanding people, uncovering meaningful human truths, and influencing the future of products through deep customer empathy, this role puts you at the centre of CoinDCX's most important business decisions.
   

  

 ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help build one of India's most impactful Consumer Insights functions.

title: Lead Product Designer (HRIS)
description:
**This role is for one of our partner companies ( workforce management, series G, Pre\-IPO)** 




**Comp.** 




  





**About:** 




  





 The HRIS is the system of record for employee data across the platform. When information about an employee changes, it can affect workflows across HR, payroll, IT, Finance, and more. As the Product Design Lead, you will own the end\-to\-end design of the HRIS product, turning multilayered enterprise complexity into workflows that are fast, intuitive, and error\-proof.
 



 The role demands strong information architecture, systems thinking, and the judgment to make high\-stakes design calls independently.
 



 You will report to the Director of Design based in the US and collaborate daily with the HRIS product and engineering team in Bengaluru.
 



  





**What you'll own:** 




  




* **End\-to\-end design of the HRIS product.** 
 Design core workflows across hiring, employee data, organisational changes, and compliance, making them simple to use by employees and powerful for administrators.
* **Information architecture.** 
 Define how complex employee data, permissions, workflows, and product relationships are organised. Help users understand where they are, what requires their attention, and how their actions affect other parts of the platform.
* **Stakeholder collaboration and design rationale.** 
 Work directly with PMs, engineers, and business counterparts; defend design decisions with evidence and trade\-off thinking.
* **Revamp inherited systems.** 
 Improve established workflows that need to support changing customer, product, or regulatory requirements.
* **Design quality and craft standards.** 
 Set the bar for what good UX looks like on the HRIS team, working within the company's established design system.



  





**You'll be a great fit if:** 




  




* **Simplified complex enterprise products.** 
 You have owned and simplified the UX of a multi\-step, multi\-user workflow where tiny errors compound and create exponential damage to existing systems.
* **Strong information architecture instincts.** 
 You think in systems first: how flows connect, where users get lost, and how to reduce cognitive load across hundreds of screens.
* **Built for global, multi\-segment user bases.** 
 You have designed for different user groups, such as administrators, employees, managers, and executives, across multiple markets or compliance environments.
* **Worked in a multi\-product platform environment.** 
 Your design decisions had upstream and downstream effects on other products and teams, and you were able to navigate that complexity by aligning all the stakeholders involved.
* **Made high\-stakes calls independently.** 
 You can develop domain expertise quickly, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and own timelines and dependencies with limited oversight.
* **Worked in regulated and data\-intensive industries.** 
 Experience in HR technology, payroll, financial technology, compliance, identity, or another regulated and data\-intensive domain is especially relevant.

 **Senior Concept Artist** 
 to join our production team. You will be responsible for creating high\-quality 2D art assets—ranging from character concepts and environmental backgrounds to fully integrated UI layouts in Unity. The ideal candidate blends artistic talent with a practical understanding of engine implementation and mobile/web game production pipelines.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Note:** 
 Hiring for an
 **Antler\-funded startup** 
 building in the
 **next\-generation fashion \& apparel space** 
 .
 



  





**Role: Graphic Designer** 




**Location: Bangalore** 




**Budget: 7 \- 10 LPA** 




  





**About Us** 




 We’re building a Gen\-z
 **fashion brand powered by AI** 
 .
 



 Our mission is to reinvent fashion for a generation that values
 **individuality over trends and self\-expression over mass production** 
 .
 



 We’re building a brand that lives where Gen\-z lives \- Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest and the platforms shaping culture next.
 



 And we’re looking for a designer who doesn’t just make things look good, but understands
 **why they should look that way.** 




  





**The Role** 




 As a
 **Graphic Designer** 
 , you’ll work closely with the founders, creative and marketing teams to build the visual identity of a new generation fashion brand from the ground up.
 



 You’ll work across
 **social media, campaigns, product launches, performance marketing, website, creator collaborations and brand communication** 
 .
 



 This is a hands\-on startup role. You’ll be expected to take an idea from
 **“here’s what we’re thinking” → concept → design → execution** 
 , often with very little hand\-holding.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design creatives for
 **Instagram, social media, digital campaigns and brand communication**
* Develop visual concepts for product launches, campaigns and seasonal collections
* Create
 **static creatives, carousels, social assets, campaign KV and digital banners**
* Work with the content and influencer team to create assets for social platforms
* Translate brand and marketing ideas into compelling visual stories
* Collaborate with founders, marketers, content creators and fashion/design teams
* Maintain consistency across the brand's visual language while constantly evolving it
* Create multiple creative directions and iterate quickly based on feedback and performance
* Work on both
 **brand\-building and performance\-oriented creatives**
* Understand how design changes depending on the objective — whether it's building aspiration, driving clicks, communicating price or selling a product
* Keep up with
 **fashion, Gen\-z aesthetics, social trends, typography, visual culture and emerging design formats**
* Build and maintain a strong visual system as the brand scales



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **2–5 years of experience** 
 in graphic design or visual design
* **Startup experience is a MUST**
* Experience working in
 **fashion, beauty, lifestyle, D2C or consumer brands** 
 is a strong advantage
* Strong portfolio demonstrating
 **real\-world design work** 
 , not just template\-based social media creatives
* Strong command of tools such as
 **Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.**
* Strong understanding of
 **composition, typography, colour, hierarchy and visual storytelling**
* Ability to work quickly and handle multiple projects in a fast\-moving environment
* Strong attention to detail
* Someone who can take feedback without losing the intent behind the design



  





 We Care About Your Thinking, Not Just Your Portfolio
 



 We will look at your portfolio and ask you
 **why you made certain design decisions.** 




  





 For example:
 



**Imagine we have two dresses — one priced at ₹1,999 and another at ₹4,999\.** 




 How would you make the two products feel different visually?
 



 Would you change the typography?
 



 The photography treatment?
 



 The background?
 



 The colour palette?
 



 The amount of whitespace?
 



 The styling?
 



 The messaging?
 



 There isn't necessarily one correct answer.
 **We want to understand your thinking.** 




  





 If you can explain the relationship between
 **design, audience, positioning, price perception and business objective** 
 , you'll do well here.
 



  





**You'll Thrive Here If You...** 



* Think beyond
 **“Does this look nice?”** 
 and ask
 **“What is this design trying to achieve?”**
* Can explain the reasoning behind your creative choices
* Understand that design is both
 **art and communication**
* Have strong visual taste and an even stronger point of view
* Know what works on Instagram without simply copying what's trending
* Can move fast without compromising on quality
* Enjoy working in ambiguity and figuring things out yourself
* Want significant ownership rather than a narrowly defined design role
* Are excited by the opportunity to help shape the visual identity of a brand
 **from Day 1**



  





**Important** 



* **Startup experience is mandatory**
* Candidates with frequent
 **year\-on\-year job changes/hopping** 
 may not be a fit for this role
* **Immediate joiners or candidates with ≤30 days notice period preferred**
* A
 **strong portfolio is mandatory**
* Be prepared to walk us through your portfolio and explain the
 **thinking behind your design decisions**



**If you believe great design isn't just about making something beautiful, but making people feel, understand and act, we'd love to see your work.**

title: Product Designer
description:
**About the company:** 




 Cradlewise is a San\-Francisco, Bangalore and Pune based sleep tech company. We build innovative solutions for parents. Our products are designed to take the stress out of parenthood.
 



 Our first product \- the award winning Cradlewise smart crib comes with an integrated baby monitor that senses early signs of wakeup, learns from the baby’s sleep patterns and starts to bounce along with music to soothe the baby back to sleep—just like a parent! → See how our smart crib works
 



  





 We are working to reimagine the baby nursery to make it smart, intuitive and delightful. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values, and our culture!
 



  





**About the Cradlewise Design Team** 




 Cradlewise Design is a close\-knit team of User\-Experience Designers, Visual Designers and Video editors from all over India. We create experiences to help every family sleep and live better, through science\-driven solutions, and it's the role of the team to humanize and create every touchpoint with empathy and support.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Cradlewise solved sleep for babies. Now we're going after what comes next: a brand\-new software product in the kids category, starting from a blank page. We're hiring a Product Designer to own the design from zero to one: the research, the flows, the visual language, the first shipped version. You'll sit in on parent interviews happening right now, sketch the same week, and watch your work decide what we build. You'll also shape the Cradlewise app and web portal that thousands of families already use daily.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Design a 0\-to\-1 product in the kids category: from discovery and user research through flows, prototypes, and the first release.
* Create a visual language that works for two audiences at once: kids and their parents.
* Design and improve the Cradlewise app and web portal, including our subscriptions experience, funnels, and retention experiments.
* Prototype fast, test with real families, and iterate. Speed matters more than polish at this stage.
* Contribute to our design system for consistency across products.
* Work directly with founders, product, tech, content, and marketing to take designs live.
* Keep designs accessible and grounded in human\-factors principles.



  





**What you’ll bring to the role:** 



* 4–5 years of experience in product/UI/UX design.
* A portfolio that can demonstrate your ability to work on modern digital interfaces.
* Craft beautiful experiences that visually present the user interface so information is easy to read, understand and find.
* Thorough understanding of the design process to perform research, build workflows and user journeys, execute design with high quality prototypes and test mock\-ups for feedback.
* Understanding and implementation of best practices including accessibility standards and human factors.
* A positive attitude and enthusiasm, willingness to iterate quickly and strong bias for action.
* Passion for design and simplifying complex problems, and a hunger to experiment with new and innovative solutions.
* A humble team player who is a great partner to work with for cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to learn from your mistakes and absorb feedback.
* Great communication skills, product thinking (why’s) and comfort with presenting and discussing designs.
* High proficiency in design tools like Figma and AI tooling to intelligently design creative experiences.
* Ability to learn and use analytics tools such as GA4, Mixpanel, and Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and make informed design decisions.



  





**Academic qualifications** 



* Bachelors or MA/MS degree (or higher) in Design (interaction, graphic or visual communication) or equivalent practical experience.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* A founding\-designer seat on a 0\-to\-1 product: blank canvas, full ownership.
* Direct access to founders and daily collaboration with product and engineering.
* Autonomy to ideate, experiment, and execute, with regular reviews to accelerate your growth.
* A close\-knit, learning\-oriented design team and a hybrid working setup.
* Competitive salary.



  





**Location:** 




 Bangalore, Work from office.
 



  





 Follow us on LinkedIn.
 



 Sounds like a good fit for you? :
 



 Are you excited to work collaboratively with design, product, and engineering?
 



 Do you thrive in fast\-paced, unstructured environments that require you to wear many hats and think on your feet?
 



 Are you an independent thinker, a fast learner, and you're hungry to be a part of a high\-performing team?
 



 Come join us!
