title: Creative Lead
description:
Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Creative Lead for Production owns quality and pipeline health for a pod of designers delivering creative across Video, Banner, Native, Interstitial, and Playable formats. You are the QA gate — every asset passes through your sign\-off before it ships.
   

  

 You sit at the seam between Creative Strategy and Production: translating briefs into executable direction, maintaining the team's output velocity, and protecting quality even at peak volume (20–30 tickets per day). This is not a pure management role. You are expected to stay hands\-on — personally concepting, storyboarding, and executing — while leading, coaching, and developing your direct reports.
   

  

 The right person sets the creative bar rather than enforcing someone else's, and finds the balance between forward output and quality control without dropping either.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own production quality standards across all formats and enforce the QA matrix — every asset passes your sign\-off before shipping
* Direct creative execution across channels and set the bar for what "done" looks like
* Manage the QA pipeline end to end: review and approve RZR Studio submissions, flag revisions, track resolution at 20–30 tickets per day at peak, with first\-review turnaround under 2 hours
* Triage and allocate bandwidth across your pod, flag bottlenecks before they become backlogs, and deliver a daily pulse on pipeline health
* Coordinate with the Creative Strategy Lead on brief\-to\-execution alignment, escalating collated feedback when strategic creative revisions run heavy on first pass
* Drive production workflow and tooling improvements, owning the team's iteration velocity and output volume targets
* Maintain and update the Playbook and RZR Studio Templates on every new account launch, with same\-day turnaround
* Run 1:1s and development check\-ins with all direct reports; report pod output metrics to the Director of Creative Services


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* 7\+ years in creative production, motion or graphic design, or multimedia design within digital, gaming, or adtech
* Hands\-on fluency across the Adobe Suite — Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects — at a level where you can personally concept, storyboard, and execute, not just review
* Proven QA and production management experience: owning sign\-off standards, SLA turnaround, and quality bars across multiple formats including Video, Banner, Native, Interstitial, and/or Playable
* Experience managing production pipelines at volume (20\+ tickets per day equivalent) without quality slipping
* Track record of personally shipping strong concept work — storyboards, key art, or campaign creative — not just directing others' output
* Familiarity with platform\-specific creative specs and constraints across DSP, Meta, TikTok, and ASO
* Experience managing and developing a team of designers (3\+ direct reports), coaching on craft not just workflow
* Comfortable translating strategic briefs into clear, executable production direction
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to give craft feedback that lands and escalate risk clearly


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Prior experience in adtech, programmatic advertising, or mobile advertising creative
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted production tooling and a clear view on where human craft judgment must stay in the loop
* Experience working across international or distributed creative teams


 Work Setup
   

  

 This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, India, requiring regular onsite attendance for collaboration, reviews, and team activities. This is not a fully remote position. Creative team members may occasionally be required to work onsite more frequently depending on project demands.
   

  

 Why Join RZR?
   

  

* You set the creative bar, not just enforce someone else's — this is a high\-impact production leadership role with genuine ownership over quality standards across the pod
* Hands\-on craft alongside people leadership — this is not a pure management track. You will stay in the work, personally concepting and executing alongside directing your team

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Runable:** 




  





 Runable builds software that helps small and medium businesses grow — the tooling, automation, and workflows that let a lean team operate like a much larger one. Our users are business owners and operators, not power users of software, so how clear the product feels decides whether it gets adopted at all.
 



  





**The Role:** 




  





 We are hiring a UI/UX Designer to own the experience of what we ship — from the messy problem to the pixels engineers build against. You will do both halves of the job: the thinking that decides what a screen should do, and the craft that makes it look like it was designed on purpose.
 



 This is a small team, so you will own product areas outright rather than decorating someone else's flows. Expect to sit with real customer problems, work directly with engineers, and see your designs live within weeks. Our users are non\-technical and time\-poor — every unnecessary step you remove is the actual output of this role.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Own end\-to\-end design for product areas: problem framing, user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity UI, and prototypes.
* Turn vague requests and customer pain into clear, shippable design solutions with a defensible rationale.
* Design for clarity over cleverness — our users are SMB operators who need to get one thing done fast.
* Build and extend our design system: components, patterns, tokens, and documentation that keep the product coherent.
* Work directly with engineers through implementation, reviewing builds and fixing the gap between design and shipped UI.
* Prototype interactions and motion where static screens cannot answer the question.
* Run lightweight research and usability testing — talk to users, watch them struggle, change the design.
* Use analytics and session data to find where people drop off, then design and measure the fix.
* Design responsive interfaces that hold up across desktop and mobile, with accessibility treated as a default.
* Contribute to marketing and brand surfaces when needed — landing pages, in\-product education, and launch assets.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* 4–8 years designing digital products, with a portfolio of shipped work — not concept pieces.
* Currently managing a design team of at least 2–4 people, with direct responsibility for their work and growth.
* Strong UI craft: layout, typography, hierarchy, colour, and spacing discipline you can explain rather than eyeball.
* Genuine UX ability: you can map a flow, simplify a process, and justify structure with user reasoning.
* Expert in Figma — components, auto\-layout, variants, and prototypes that engineers can actually work from.
* Experience designing SaaS, dashboards, or complex workflow tools where information density is a real problem.
* Working understanding of front\-end constraints and comfortable collaborating closely with engineers.
* Experience building or contributing to a design system.
* Comfortable using AI tools to move faster — exploring directions, generating assets, and cutting production time.
* Able to present and defend design decisions to founders and engineers, and to change your mind when the argument is better.
* Self\-driven in a low\-process environment: you find the problems worth designing for instead of waiting for tickets.



  





**Nice to Have:** 




  




* Startup experience where you were the only or first designer.
* Experience designing for non\-technical or SMB audiences.
* Interaction and motion design skill (Rive, Lottie, After Effects, or Figma's motion tooling).
* Ability to build with front\-end code or AI app builders to ship simple things yourself.
* Illustration, iconography, or brand design range.
* Exposure to AI\-native product patterns — chat, agents, generative interfaces.



  





**Why Runable:** 




  




* Real ownership: your design decisions ship, and you see how SMB customers respond within weeks.
* Small team, high leverage — design quality is a company\-level differentiator here, not a finishing step.
* Direct access to founders and customers; short feedback loops, minimal process.
* Room to shape the design system and the product's visual direction as we scale.
* Compensation is benchmarked to experience and impact, and discussed openly in the first conversation.

We solve real\-world problems in the home services industry, bringing innovative and delightful solutions to traditional workflows. Our product designers work closely with product managers, engineers, product marketers, and thousands of our users to make their lives easier through technology, including Titan Intelligence, our AI platform. We embrace agile development and design thinking to ship dozens of new features every month, and we measure our success by our customers' success.
   

  

 We're building out our Bangalore design team and looking for a talented AI\-First Staff Product Designer who enjoys solving complex problems with data\-driven, AI\-powered solutions. This person will design experiences that put Titan Intelligence at the core of the product, not bolted on as an afterthought, across desktop, tablet, and mobile touchpoints. You'll bring a balanced toolkit of research, interface design, and prototyping capabilities, with real fluency in designing for AI\-driven and agentic workflows.
   

  

 As a Staff Product Designer, you're capable of running discovery research with users, creating journey maps and task flows, conducting user interviews, whiteboarding task flows, mocking up interface screens, and prototyping solutions for testing \- including AI\-assisted prototyping tools that speed up how fast ideas go from concept to validation. You set a strong example and provide thoughtful direction within the team, often acting as a mentor and coach. You're known across the company for your creativity, leadership, and innovation.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to shape one of the largest platforms disrupting the home services industry, and to help define what AI\-first product design looks like at ServiceTitan's growing Bangalore hub.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Build positive, collaborative relationships across product, engineering, and research to explore, build, and ship your work
* Develop deep expertise across multiple product problem areas, with a focus on where Titan Intelligence and AI capabilities can meaningfully improve the experience
* Design human\-AI interaction patterns, including agentic workflows, confidence and trust cues, human\-in\-the\-loop review steps, and graceful handling of AI uncertainty or error
* Quickly prototype solutions to visual and interaction problems, using AI\-assisted design and prototyping tools to accelerate iteration
* Talk to users to understand their problems, current pain points, and comfort level with AI\-driven features
* Design experiences that are simple, elegant, and solve real problems
* Use remote tools to whiteboard, create wireframes, and design in Figma, iterating toward a shippable solution
* Validate product ideas through experimental design and research approaches, including testing AI feature outputs for usefulness and trust
* Ship valuable, high\-quality work without sacrificing speed
* Help more junior designers build empathy for our users and advocate for user needs, especially as AI changes how they work
* Represent our users in product strategy and roadmap discussions
* Review product design work and give constructive feedback
* Actively mentor designers, helping them build context, strong decision\-making skills, and empathy for our users.


**What You’ll Bring:**
* Experience designing B2B products, particularly modern SaaS or enterprise platforms
* Strong UX reasoning, with a proven ability to solve complex, ambiguous product problems through simple design solutions
* Direct experience designing AI\-powered or AI\-assisted product features \- for example, generative AI, recommendation systems, copilots, or agentic workflows \- with a clear point of view on how to make AI experiences trustworthy and useful
* An outstanding portfolio showing a range of UX, interaction, and visual design work, plus idea generation or prototyping used to explore and convey design solutions
* Deep experience with UX research and end\-to\-end ownership, taking a problem from discovery through shipped solution
* Startup or fast\-paced environment experience, with the self\-starter mindset to match
* High attention to detail in both visual design and copy
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain the "why" behind your design rationale to your team and stakeholders
* A thought partner and leader others turn to for design judgment and point of view
* At least one year of experience directly managing a team of two or more people


 ‌
   

  

**Be Human With Us:**
 Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
   

  

**Use of AI Technology:**
 We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.
   

  

 At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Lottie Creator (App Experience)
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016\. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life\-till\-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android\-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
   

  

 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 About The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a Motion Designer \& Lottie Creator to own the visual design and animation for our highest\-impact app real estate: the homepage masthead. You will own the complete end\-to\-end creative pipeline: designing static vector assets from scratch based on product briefs, and then animating them into high\-performance, lightweight Lottie files. Working at the intersection of visual illustration, motion craft, and product performance, you will ensure every asset looks premium, loads instantly, and runs smoothly on entry\-level smartphones across India.
   

  

 Focus Area 1: End\-to\-End Asset Design \& Motion
   

  

* Illustration \& Vector Asset Creation: Design custom, high\-quality static vector illustrations, icons, and visual UI assets in Figma/Illustrator that align with brand guidelines and category needs.
* Lottie Animation \& Craft: Turn your static designs into smooth, expressive Lottie animations using After Effects, bringing product concepts (like digital gold or credit cards) to life.
* Homepage Masthead Real Estate: Own the visual presentation of primary homepage banners, ensuring designs drive immediate category recognition and high tap\-through rates.
* Category Visual Storytelling: Translate complex financial products into simple, intuitive visual metaphors that guide user navigation.


 Focus Area 2: Product Alignment \& Technical Optimization
   

  

* Performance \& Asset Compression: Optimize JSON and Lottie files to ensure minimal file sizes and low memory usage, preventing app lag or battery drain.
* Device Compatibility \& Accessibility: Test and optimize animations across a wide spectrum of mobile devices, ensuring seamless playback on entry\-level Android smartphones and varied screen sizes.
* Design Systems Integration: Work alongside the core UI/UX team to maintain consistent design tokens, color usage, and visual style across all custom illustrations.


 Focus Area 3: Motion Analytics \& Performance Optimization
   

  

* Tap\-Through \& Conversion Tracking: Collaborate with product analysts to review performance data on masthead assets, understanding how visual design and animation variations impact click\-through rates.
* Iterative Testing: Design and test different visual styles, layout compositions, and animation speeds to continuously improve user engagement across categories.


**Qualifications**
 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* Full\-Pipeline Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both static visual/illustration design skills (Figma/Illustrator) and complex vector motion design (After Effects to Lottie).
* Technical Performance Mastery: Deep understanding of Lottie runtime limitations, vector optimization, layer structuring, keyframe efficiency, and JSON file size constraints for high\-scale apps.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Proven experience working alongside Product Managers, Engineers, and UI/UX Designers to ship live app features.


 Mindset To Succeed
   

  

* Designer \+ Animator Hybrid: You take equal pride in drawing the clean, static vector illustration as you do in bringing it to life with motion.
* High\-Scale User Focus: You understand our diverse user base and ensure your designs look great and play smoothly on simple, entry\-level smartphones.
* High Agency: You take full ownership of the homepage motion experience, proactively spotting dated assets and pitching new visual concepts to product teams.


**Additional Information**
 PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
   

  

 Insurance Benefits \- Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program \- Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support \- Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day\-care Support Program Mobility Benefits \- Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits \- Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits \- Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

title: Visual Communication Designer
description:
***Techrowth Pvt. Ltd. · Bengaluru — on\-site · 6\-month internship with a pre\-placement offer on the table***




***Stipend: ₹30,000/month · PPO: ₹5\.5–8\.5 LPA on conversion***




  




***The short version***

  





*We're looking for a designer who doesn't stay in one lane. Someone who can build an identity system on Monday, storyboard a 30\-second film on Wednesday, and walk a client through the thinking on Friday without losing the room.* 




*This is a six\-month internship that exists to become a full\-time job. We're not hiring interns to fill a gap, we're hiring the person we want on the team, and using six months to make sure we're both right about it.* 




*You won't be handed a template and asked to resize it. You'll be in the room where the problem gets defined which means you need taste, range, and the ability to explain why you made the choice you made.* 




  




***What you'll actually do***

  




* *Design across formats: identity systems, campaign visuals, social, packaging, motion, editorial, decks, and whatever the brief demands next*
* *Translate a strategy or a rough brief into visual directions — usually more than one, always with a point of view*
* *Present your work. Out loud. To people who will push back. Defend what's right, drop what isn't*
* *Work through revisions without losing the original idea*
* *Keep systems tight: type scales, grids, colour, file hygiene, handoff that doesn't break*
* *Sit in on strategy and client conversations, take notes, and come back with something nobody asked for but everybody needed*



  




***Who this is for***

  





*An undergraduate who is hungry not for a title, but for reps. For the kind of range you only get by shipping a lot of work, fast, under real constraints, with someone senior telling you exactly what's wrong with it.* 




*If you've been making things outside your coursework zines, posters for a friend's gig, a rebrand nobody asked for, an Instagram account where you post type experiments, we want to see that more than we want to see your final\-year submission.* 




  




***What we're looking for***

  





***Non\-negotiable***



* *A portfolio with a point of view. 3 pieces you can defend beats forty you can't*
* *Genuine multidisciplinary range, you're not just a poster person or just a UI person*
* *Strong communication. You can write a clear email, run a review, and explain a design decision in plain language. This matters as much as the craft*
* *Command of the tools: Adobe CS (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma.*
* *The ability to take blunt feedback without deflating, and to push back when you're right.*
* *Available for six months on\-site in Bengaluru.*



***Bonus points***



* *Motion (After Effects) or 3D (Blender)*
* *Illustration or hand\-lettering in your own voice*
* *Photography, art direction, or a sense for how a shoot comes together*
* *Indian type and vernacular design sensibility*
* *A side project you've kept alive for more than six months*



  




***The money, plainly***

  





  





***On conversion:***
*₹5\.5–8\.5 LPA. Where you land in that band is decided by the six months, not by your resume. What moves you up it:* 



* *Range — how many formats you can own end to end without supervision*
* *Independence — how much of a brief you can take from kickoff to delivery alone*
* *Client\-facing ability — whether we can put you in a room with a client and relax*
* *Craft consistency — your worst piece, not your best one*



*We'll tell you where you're tracking at the three\-month mark, so the conversion conversation holds no surprises.* 




  




***What else you get***

  




* *Direct mentorship — reviews with senior folks, not feedback relayed through three layers*
* *Real client work with your fingerprints on it, from week two*
* *Exposure to the strategy behind the work, not just the execution brief*
* *A portfolio that looks very different six months from now*



  




***This role is not for you if***

  




* *You want a fixed scope and a clear lane*
* *You'd rather send the file than present the file*
* *You think feedback is a personal matter*
* *You're treating this as a semester requirement rather than a job you want*

description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Stripe is investing in building out its Creative Design team within the Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) to reach users across the globe. The team designs comprehensive ad campaigns tailored for various platforms, ensuring that every visual element aligns with our marketing goals and engages our audience effectively. We create net\-new creative content and localize and adapt our work to meet the unique cultural and linguistic needs of different regions, presenting our message effectively in global languages.
   

  

 In addition to advertising and web content, we produce high\-quality designs for presentations and collateral aimed at large users and executive audiences. Our designs enhance the clarity and impact of our messages, making complex information accessible and engaging—whether for a client pitch or an executive strategy session.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Designers at Stripe's SDC bring a passion for captivating storytelling and great design. They use design systems to tell compelling stories to a variety of audiences, and are well\-versed at expanding, evolving, defining, and documenting flexible design systems that achieve bar\-raising quality and consistency for the brand at scale. They are user\-focused, business\-savvy, empathetic, and inspiring. The ideal candidate excels across a variety of styles, crisply articulates design decisions, iterates quickly, and collaborates seamlessly with marketers, product managers, leaders, other designers, and cross\-functional partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Ideate, design, and produce world\-class design solutions—both static and motion—across a range of deliverables including presentations, posters, brand art, and signage.
* Steward designers through large\-scale projects, providing art direction and ongoing guidance on creative strategy, execution, and localization.
* Work across a wide variety of mediums (physical, digital, and everything in between) to create immersive storytelling and creative content that brings Stripe's brand and product stories to life.
* Bring design concepts to life through storyboarding, comps, and creative presentations, iterating based on stakeholder feedback and internal testing.
* Collaborate with copywriters, static and motion designers, marketers, and ad operations to develop visionary concepts that engage a global audience.
* Mentor designers in best practices and ideation, fostering an environment where everyone learns and grows.
* Present ideas in a clear, focused way that builds consensus within the team and with stakeholders.
* Proactively identify and implement process improvements through automation and AI integration to enhance design quality and efficiency.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of relevant design and art direction experience, with a focus on technical or product\-driven companies.
* Strong track record of independently delivering high\-quality work and influencing the output of other designers and cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Figma, Canva, and the Adobe Creative Cloud suite (motion and statics).
* Experience managing or mentoring a team of designers.
* Ability to express and communicate a brand through distinct graphics, patterns, motion, interaction, and experiences.
* A hands\-on maker with the skills to effectively communicate concepts, direction, and decisions to teams and external partners.
* Ability to balance speed and quality, consistently delivering challenging, interesting, and pixel\-perfect work.
* Persuasive and receptive to feedback; able to clearly explain work, process, and decisions.
* Comfortable working flexible hours, including late evenings (IST), to collaborate in real time with global stakeholders.
* Highly detail\-oriented, with a drive for pixel\-perfect craft.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Multidisciplinary creative comfortable working across different mediums and excited about experimenting with new technologies.
* Prior people management experience, with a track record of hiring, developing, and growing design talent.
* Experienced at facilitating stakeholder alignment and advocating for design quality.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

 You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast\-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Product Designer at Coram AI, you’ll design the end\-to\-end experience for an AI\-native video security platform used by security and operations teams to monitor, investigate, and respond to real\-world incidents. You’ll turn complex workflows (live video, AI detections, multi\-site operations, access control, and incident response) into intuitive, high\-confidence product experiences.
   

  

 You’ll have significant ownership from day one: partnering closely with product managers and engineers, speaking directly with customers, and taking work from early concepts through polished, production\-ready designs. This is a high\-impact role for a systems\-minded designer who enjoys solving technically complex B2B problems, building scalable design foundations, and shipping quickly in an early\-stage environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the product design process from early customer discovery and wireframing to high\-fidelity visual design, interactive prototyping, and developer handoff
* Design workflows for natural language video search, custom AI alert setup, interactive camera walls, and incident deep\-dive investigations
* Streamline critical operations like multi\-site security oversight, role\-based access control, visitor management, and emergency response coordination
* Build, expand, and maintain Coram AI’s UI component library and design system in Figma to ensure speed, accessibility, and visual consistency across desktop and mobile
* Talk directly with security operators, IT directors, and facility leaders to understand workflows, iterate on user feedback, and validate design solutions
* Collaborate daily with PMs and front\-end/AI engineers in a fast\-paced, high\-ship\-velocity environment


**What We Offer**

* Attractive Health benefits for you and family
* Flexible paid time off
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)
* Referral bonuses


**Skills And Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer, with a proven track record building complex B2B SaaS platforms, data\-dense web applications, or AI tools
* Clear case studies demonstrating end\-to\-end design execution, complex problem solving, high visual polish, and systemic UI thinking
* Expertise in component architecture, autolayout, prototyping, and design system governance
* Ability to understand technical constraints surrounding live\-video streams, real\-time telemetry, and AI detection models to design viable, elegant solutions

 We're on a mission to transform a $50B\+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting\-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real\-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI\-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.
   

  

 Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex\-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex\-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world.  In this role, you will take ownership of key areas within our Enterprise platform, moving from early\-stage discovery and logic mapping to high\-fidelity UI and rigorous developer handoff. **What You’ll Do**

* Data\-Informed Advocacy: Use research and product analytics to validate your design decisions, working closely with our UXR and Content partners to build a well\-rounded vision.
* Global Collaboration: Work as part of a global team spanning Berlin, India, and San Francisco. You’ll facilitate design rituals and syncs that bridge time zones and cultures.


**What We’re Looking For**

* Full\-Stack proficiency: A portfolio that demonstrates strength in both UX Architecture (logic, edge cases, user flows) and UI Design (layout, hierarchy, and interaction).
* Figma expertise: Proficiency in Figma is required; you use auto\-layout and components to build organized, scalable files.
* Shipped B2B Work: A proven track record of shipping impactful work in a B2B or B2B2C environment.

Your work will directly shape how a fast\-growing AI startup shows up to the world.  What Working With Us Looks Like

* Long term builders wanted: we're looking for people who want to grow with the company's mission, not just a role or a single manager.

**Team**
**About Target**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
   

  

 Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are currently hiring for the Advanced AI Pyramid at Target. As a Senior Product Designer, you'll help shape how Target designs AI\-enabled and agentic experiences, from early interaction models through to patterns other teams can build on. This role focuses on tools and workflows used by technical and product teams building these experiences, while flexing to other guest and team member experiences as priorities evolve.
   

  

 You'll work through open, evolving problems alongside product and engineering, turning early ideas into direction a team can build against. Much of this work is systems\-level: a pattern needs to hold up across multiple teams and use cases, not just one screen
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and prototype agentic experiences: multi\-agent entry points, cross\-domain surfaces, and the moments where a system's reasoning needs to be visible and trustworthy.
* Build fast demonstrations that give internal teams something concrete to react to.
* Work directly with product teams adopting agentic AI. Take their early idea and shape it into a real product direction alongside their engineering counterparts.
* Design how trust and autonomy actually show up in an experience: guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop moments, and how the system's provenance is surfaced to the person using it.
* Hold your work to a high standard across journey maps, flows, and prototypes. Think about whether a pattern holds up beyond the specific team it started with.
* Few precedents exist for this kind of work, so you'll often be inventing the approach as much as the product. Look to the industry for what's working elsewhere, but expect to build new methods where nothing established fits.


**What We're Looking For**
* 6\+ years in product/UX design, with a portfolio that shows you can think past a single user and a single interface, beyond screen\-level craft alone.
* Direct exposure to AI/agentic product design, developer experience design, or adjacent work like complex workflow tools, platform/infrastructure UX, or design systems at enterprise scale. You should already be building in this space in some form, even outside a formal role.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You'll sometimes design against a model or platform that's still being finalized, which means structuring your own thinking first, then bringing that structure to the work itself.
* Advanced Figma proficiency and a working understanding of WCAG accessibility standards.


**Nice to Have**
* Some technical fluency \- API literacy, design\-to\-code tools, or comfort prototyping with code, so you can move fast without waiting on an engineer for every iteration.
* Experience contributing to a design system.
* The ability to walk someone through why you made a decision, beyond what the final screens look like.
* Writing, talks, side projects, or anything else that shows genuine interest in this space. Doesn't need to be public \- sharing it alongside your portfolio works too.


**A Note on Fit**
 Take this role if you'd rather help define how this practice works than step into one that's already set. You should be as interested in how trust and autonomy should feel as in what an agent can technically do. Expect to be building the ground you're standing on.

description:
**ABOUT CRACK THE CAMPUS:**




  





 Crack The Campus is an emerging EdTech platform focused on bridging the campus\-to\-career gap for engineering students and universities. The platform integrates AI\-proctored coding assessments, structured technical preparation pathways, and real\-time student readiness metrics (CTC Score) to streamline hiring outcomes for institutions and corporate recruiters.

 We are looking for a creative and user\-focused UI/UX Developer to design and build intuitive, responsive, and engaging interfaces for our web applications. You will work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to transform complex workflows—such as proctored exam sessions, analytics dashboards, and student learning tracks—into seamless digital experiences that elevate
 



 CrackTheCampus products.

 • Figma Prototyping
 



 • FigJam (User Flows \& Wireframes)
 



 • Figma AI
 



 • Adobe Photoshop
 



 • Adobe XD
 



 • Sketch
 



 • Canva

 • Facilitate brainstorming sessions, user flows, journey maps, and low\-fidelity wireframes using FigJam and Sketch.

title: Associate Product Designer
description:
About
 **Bright Money** 




  






 Bright
 
 Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle\-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle\-income consumers living paycheck\-to\-paycheck.
 



  





 Bright is a profitable, India\-built, U.S.\-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 12 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial service marketplace revenues for loans, credit cards, and credit\-building tools.
 



  





 Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI\-driven Consumer FinTech for middle\-income consumers.
 



  





 The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle\-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.
 



  





 Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.
 



  





 Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex\-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data\-driven, fast\-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.
 



  





**What is the team \& role about?** 




  





 We are seeking a Junior Product Designer with a passion for finding solutions that allow customers to intuitively use our products. The ideal candidate is eager to grow at every stage of the design process, excited to use AI to design and build faster, and always focused on the needs of the customer. You will work with other designers and cross\-functional team members, and will rely heavily on both qualitative and quantitative data to make informed decisions.
 



  




* You will receive training in building incredible products and features from highly experienced consumer product veterans.
* You will work on an AI\-native design team, learning to use AI across the entire design process rather than as a bolt\-on.
* You will build the cross\-functional and 0\-to\-1 skills needed to one day become a startup founder yourself.
* You will build advanced skills in A.I. and Finance, trained by experienced tech founders who have this expertise.
* You will build a deep end\-to\-end understanding of building a customer\-focused financial product from scratch.



  





**What you will do?** 




  




* Collaborate with teammates across product and engineering to define, build, and release new products and features.
* Construct user flows, wireframes, and prototypes that effectively communicate design concepts for validation.
* Use AI tools to explore ideas and move to high\-fidelity quickly, and experiment with vibe\-coding prototypes to test concepts in the real product.
* Develop and deliver well\-documented, high\-fidelity visuals that accurately represent Bright Money's brand and design system standards.
* Participate in user interviews and research to better understand customer needs.
* Stay curious about how the best AI products are evolving their UI/UX, and bring those learnings into your work.
* Contribute thinking to product features and the roadmap.
* Contribute to and positively shape the design team's culture through collaboration, feedback, and process iteration.



  





**Ideal candidate profile looks like?** 




**Experience \& Background:** 




  




* 0\-1 years of UI/UX experience with a relevant degree in Human Centered Design, or a related field of study.
* Curiosity and eagerness to use AI design and prototyping tools to raise both the speed and the quality of your work.
* Willingness to build simple functional prototypes, including through vibe\-coding, to pressure\-test ideas.
* Strong design craft skills including interaction, visual, and service design.
* A strong grasp of tools like Figma, the Adobe suite, and prototyping tools.
* Ability to understand business objectives, direction, and needs expressed from multiple inputs ranging from marketing, business, and technical teams.
* Experience across the design process including user research, wireframing, prototyping, visual design, interaction design, and usability testing.
* Interest in designing mobile app interfaces for consumer products.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of web and mobile design and interface guidelines.
* Curiosity for user experience research, both to design new products and to improve existing ones.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to discuss and convey design principles and strategies to stakeholders.
* Strong product thinking and a desire to collaborate closely with PMs and engineers.
* An excellent portfolio that demonstrates systematic and creative design thinking, as well as a strong understanding of best practices.
* Passion for a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment.



  





**What Bright Offers?** 




  




* A profitable sub\-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P\&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data\-driven, high\-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week

title: Game Designer
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, highly driven game designer who knows mobile free\-to\-play games inside out and is genuinely excited about building AI games. If you can take an idea from a rough prototype to a live game players love, we want to talk.
 



  





**Our mission:** 




 We want to build the first globally competitive games studio out of India, one that can go head to head with Timi/Tencent, Supercell, and Activision Blizzard.
 



 Greatness, for us, means taking on hard problems and refusing to settle. We care about it in the games we ship, and even more in the people and the company we’re building. We’re not there yet. We’re looking for someone exceptional to help us get there.
 



  





**Role \& key responsibilities:** 




 Veteran or up\-and\-comer. What we care about is your skill, your drive, and how much you love games.
 


* **Design for mobile free\-to\-play.** 
 Own gameplay, core loops, progression, and metagame for our mobile F2P games, across midcore, RPG, roguelike, and whatever genre fits the idea. Build systems that hook players in the first session and keep them coming back for months: retention, economy, and a session flow that feels right on a phone.
* **Take games from idea to live.** 
 Prototype fast, test, ship. You’ll be hands\-on across the whole arc, from early prototype through soft launch and into live operation, and you’ll drive the game from concept to live, not just individual features.
* **Build with AI by default.** 
 Use AI as a core part of how you work, not a bolt\-on. Prototype mechanics, generate and test content, and tighten your iteration loop with it. And because we build AI games, you’ll help design experiences that only work
 *because* 
 AI sits at the center of them. We expect you to stay ahead of what these tools can do.
* **Design documentation.** 
 Write clear specs and feature docs that tell the team exactly how a mechanic, system, control, or piece of content should work.
* **Quality \& polish.** 
 Hold the quality bar. Work closely with engineers and artists so every feature and asset feels great in players’ hands.
* **Market analysis.** 
 Study the top mobile F2P games across genres. Pull apart what makes them work, from monetization to live\-ops to feature design, and turn that into sharp breakdowns that feed our own decisions.
* **Playtesting \& feedback.** 
 Run internal and external playtests. Gather feedback and gameplay data, read what players are actually telling you, and iterate.



  





**What we’re looking for:** 



* **You live in mobile F2P.** 
 You play the best mobile F2P games and understand why they make money and why people stay. Economy, retention, and monetization aren’t mysteries; they’re how you think about design.
* **You’re a builder who ships.** 
 You’ve taken something from nothing to done. You’d rather get a rough version in front of players this week than polish a doc for a month.
* **You’re genuinely pro\-AI.** 
 You’re excited about AI in games and in the craft of making them. You try new tools, find where they give you an edge, and you’re drawn to the kinds of games AI now makes possible.
* **High IQ and problem\-solving.** 
 Serious intellectual horsepower. You take messy design problems apart and come back with smart, systematic answers.
* **Clear, organized writer.** 
 You write specs other people can actually follow.
* **Curious and growth\-oriented.** 
 You’re always learning: new techniques, new games, new tools. You treat feedback and hard problems as the reason you’re here.
* **Analytical.** 
 You’re comfortable with data. You can break down a system or a pile of player feedback, find the pattern, and back your calls with reasoning.
* **Detail\-oriented.** 
 You sweat the small stuff that turns a good game into a great one.
* **Show us what you’ve built.** 
 Junior or senior, you have to demonstrate real design ability: shipped games, personal projects, mods, game jam entries, writing, anything that shows how you think and what you can make.

title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
Motion Graphics Designer \& Video Editor — Growth Team
   


**Location:** 
 Bangalore — Work From Office, Near RMZ Infinity, Old Madras Road
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹4–6 LPA
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Company:** 
 Kloth.me
 



  




 About Kloth
 
 Kloth is building a new way to shop for fashion — combining
 **AI, content and commerce** 
 to make discovering and buying clothes far more visual, personalised and effortless.
 



 Content is one of our biggest growth levers, and we're looking for a
 **Motion Graphics Designer \& Video Editor** 
 who can help us create content people actually stop scrolling for.
 



 We don't just want polished videos.
 



 We want
 **strong visual ideas, unexpected hooks, great motion and edits that have a real shot at beating the odds of going viral.** 



 The Role
 
 You'll sit within Kloth's
 **Growth Team** 
 and work closely with our content and performance marketing teams.
 



 This is a
 **motion\-graphics\-heavy role with significant video editing requirements.** 




**You'll take concepts, scripts, raw footage, product images, screenshots, typography, memes and AI\-generated assets and turn them into highly engaging short\-form content.** 




**Expect to ship 30–40 short\-form video edits every week.** 



 What You'll Do
 * Create high\-quality
 **motion graphics and animated content** 
 for Reels, ads and social media
* Edit
 **20–30 short\-form videos every week**
* **Design strong visual hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds**
* **Animate typography, UI elements, product imagery, illustrations and graphic assets**
* **Create transitions, kinetic typography, compositing, visual effects and motion\-led storytelling**
* **Turn relatively simple raw footage into highly engaging content through editing and motion design**
* **Build performance advertising creatives and rapidly produce multiple variations of winning concepts**
* **Work closely with the content team on scripts, hooks, storyboards and the weekly content calendar**
* **Translate creative concepts into formats that feel native to Instagram and other short\-form platforms**
* **Use AI video and image\-generation tools** 
 to create assets, scenes, effects and experimental content
* Develop reusable motion templates that allow us to increase creative output without making everything look templated
* Review performance data and help iterate on creatives based on what is actually working


 Motion Graphics Skills We're Looking For
 
 You should be highly comfortable with:
 


* **Adobe After Effects**
* **Adobe Premiere Pro**
* **Photoshop / Illustrator**
* **Canva**



 Strong skills in the following are especially valuable:
 


* Kinetic typography
* Text animation
* Motion tracking
* Masking and rotoscoping
* Compositing
* Keyframe animation
* Speed ramping
* Motion blur
* Transitions
* Product animation
* UI animation
* Sound design
* Colour correction
* Green\-screen / background replacement
* Creating motion systems and reusable templates



 You don't need to be a VFX wizard.
 



 But you should be able to look at a fairly ordinary piece of footage and think:
 



**"How do I make this dramatically more interesting?"** 



 Video Editing Matters Just as Much
 
 Motion graphics is the core skill, but this is
 **not a pure animation role** 
 .
 



 A significant part of your job will involve editing real footage.
 



 You should have a strong instinct for:
 


* Hooks
* Pacing
* Jump cuts
* Music
* Sound effects
* Captions
* Reaction shots
* Pattern interrupts
* Story progression
* Retention editing
* Creating multiple cuts of the same idea



 You should understand that a great short\-form edit is often less about cinematic perfection and more about
 **keeping someone watching for another second.** 



 AI Skills Matter
 
 We expect you to actively use generative AI as part of your creative workflow.
 



 You should be comfortable experimenting with tools for:
 


* Text\-to\-video
* Image\-to\-video
* AI\-generated scenes
* AI characters and avatars
* Image generation
* Generative visual effects
* Voice generation
* Background replacement
* AI\-assisted editing
* Concept prototyping



 We don't care whether your favourite tool today is Runway, Kling, Veo, Midjourney or something released three weeks from now.
 



 We care that you're constantly figuring out
 **what AI lets you create that wasn't practical before.** 



 You Should Also Be a Content Thinker
 
 We don't want someone who waits for a perfectly written brief and then opens After Effects.
 



 You'll be expected to actively contribute ideas.
 



 That means participating in:
 


* Content brainstorming
* Writing hooks
* Improving scripts
* Storyboarding
* Trend spotting
* Developing recurring content formats
* Ad creative ideation
* Content calendar planning



 You'll work with marketers and content creators, but you should be capable of saying:
 



**"This opening won't work. Let's try this instead."** 



 What Success Looks Like
 
 Your work should help Kloth create content that makes people:
 



**Stop. Watch. Share. Click. Buy.** 




**We'll care about things like:** 



* Creative output
* Speed
* Watch time and retention
* Hook performance
* Shares and engagement
* Paid\-ad performance
* Number of new formats tested
* Frequency of breakout creatives



 We'd rather test
 **10 genuinely interesting ideas** 
 than spend a week polishing one safe video.
 


 You'll Probably Love This Role If
 * After Effects feels like home
* You obsess over interesting transitions and typography
* You save ads and Reels because you're trying to reverse\-engineer how they were made
* You can edit extremely quickly
* You have opinions about what happens in the first 2 seconds of a Reel
* You enjoy combining design, editing, memes, pop culture and AI
* You experiment with new AI tools before someone asks you to
* You want your creative work to have a measurable impact on the growth of a startup


 Work Setup
 
 This is a
 **full\-time Work From Office role in Bangalore.** 




**And yes — you get a Mac mini to work on.** 




**You'll have significant creative freedom, a high volume of ideas and assets to play with, and extremely fast feedback on whether your work is actually performing.** 



 Compensation
 
**₹4–6 LPA** 
 , depending on experience, portfolio, creative ability and speed.
 


 How to Apply
 
 Please share:
 


1. Your CV
2. Your motion graphics / video editing portfolio
3. **5 short\-form videos or motion pieces you're most proud of**
4. **Any AI\-generated creative experiments you've made**



**A strong portfolio matters significantly more to us than your degree.** 



* **Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.**

title: Product Engineer(2 to 5 Yrs)
description:
Framsikt Technologies is looking for a Product Engineer to join our high\-performing R\&D center in Bangalore. This isn’t a standard development role—this is for an engineer who wants to build great products, work closely with Product and Design, and grow into an independent, end\-to\-end product engineer in an AI\-native engineering environment.
 



  





  





**The Mission:** 




  





 Framsikt is a critical pillar of the Visma Group, one of Europe's leading software companies. Our mission is direct and high\-stakes: we power the technology behind Norway’s public sector management. Our platform is the central nervous system for strategic planning and financial workflows for over 300 municipalities, enabling data\-driven decisions that impact the lives of 5\.4 million citizens.
 



  





 When you build here, your code ensures that schools are funded, infrastructure is planned, and public resources are optimized for an entire nation. This isn't just another SaaS product; it's the digital foundation of a society.
   





  





**The Role: Autonomy \& AI\-First Development** 




  





 We are moving past the era of "manual" coding.
 



  





 At Framsikt, we expect engineers to use AI as a core part of how they build software. As a Developing Product Engineer, you will build production features while learning to use AI coding tools, agentic workflows, and context engineering to make your development faster and more effective.
 



  





 You will work with experienced engineers to solve problems, make sound technical decisions, and gradually take greater ownership of features from discovery through production.
 



  




* Build AI\-first: Use AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Devin, or Windsurf for coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
* Build for scale: Apply common engineering patterns across architecture, APIs, data, security, and performance with guidance from experienced engineers.
* Engineer the context: Write structured prompts, provide the right codebase context and constraints, and learn how to guide AI tools towards reliable outcomes.
* Own quality: Write unit tests, contribute to CI/CD, participate in code reviews, and use observability tools to understand and improve production systems.
* Shape the product: Partner closely with Product and Design, bring technical thinking into discovery, and turn prototypes into production with speed and clarity.



  





**The Engineering Culture: Deep Focus over Shallow Output** 




  





 We despise "the feature factory." Our Bangalore R\&D center is a high\-trust, low\-overhead environment designed for engineers who love their craft. We prioritize deep work and systems thinking. You will find a flat hierarchy where the best idea wins, regardless of tenure.
 



  





 We actively encourage "breaking things" in the pursuit of better LLM orchestration and agentic design paradigms. If you are the type of engineer who spends their weekends experimenting with new model evaluations or building custom CLI tools to automate your own job, you will be among peers here.
 



  

  





**What You’ll Bring?** 




  





**Eligibility** 




  




* Education : Any professional technical graduation or masters
* 2\+ years of engineering excellence, ideally with C\#, SQL, Angular, and TypeScript (Azure is a plus)
* We are technology\-agnostic and value strong engineering fundamentals above specific technology experience, as long as you are open to working with the Microsoft technology stack mentioned above.
* Good at problem solving, curious soul and ability to learn quickly and agile



  





**You are a perfect fit if you:** 




  




* Have a good foundation in software engineering, APIs, data modeling, testing, and application architecture.
* Can independently deliver well\-defined features and seek guidance when solving complex or unfamiliar problems.
* See AI coding agents as a force multiplier and are willing to make them part of your everyday engineering workflow.
* Enjoy experimenting with AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Devin, or Windsurf.
* Can write structured prompts and provide the context and constraints needed to get useful results from AI tools.Care about code quality, reliability, maintainability, and good engineering practices even when moving fast.
* Enjoy working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to turn ideas and prototypes into production.
* Are comfortable receiving feedback, learning from experienced engineers, and taking increasing ownership of your work.



  





**Our Culture : Built on the following core three values:** 




  




* Reliable – We deliver with ownership, quality and integrity.
* Helpful – We succeed by supporting each other and our customers.
* Engaged – We stay curious, take initiative and continuously improve.

****About The Company:****
 Cradlewise is a San\-Francisco, Bangalore and Pune based sleep tech company. We build innovative solutions for parents. Our products are designed to take the stress out of parenthood.
   

  

 Our first product \- the award winning Cradlewise smart crib comes with an integrated baby monitor that senses early signs of wakeup, learns from the baby’s sleep patterns and starts to bounce along with music to soothe the baby back to sleep—just like a parent! → See how our smart crib works
   

  

 We are working to reimagine the baby nursery to make it smart, intuitive and delightful. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values, and our culture!
   

  

****About The Cradlewise Design Team****
 Cradlewise Design is a close\-knit team of User\-Experience Designers, Visual Designers and Video editors from all over India. We create experiences to help every family sleep and live better, through science\-driven solutions, and it's the role of the team to humanize and create every touchpoint with empathy and support.
   

  

****About The Role****
 Cradlewise solved sleep for babies. Now we're going after what comes next: a brand\-new software product in the kids category, starting from a blank page. We're hiring a Product Designer to own the design from zero to one: the research, the flows, the visual language, the first shipped version. You'll sit in on parent interviews happening right now, sketch the same week, and watch your work decide what we build. You'll also shape the Cradlewise app and web portal that thousands of families already use daily.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Design a 0\-to\-1 product in the kids category: from discovery and user research through flows, prototypes, and the first release.
* Create a visual language that works for two audiences at once: kids and their parents.
* Design and improve the Cradlewise app and web portal, including our subscriptions experience, funnels, and retention experiments.
* Prototype fast, test with real families, and iterate. Speed matters more than polish at this stage.
* Contribute to our design system for consistency across products.
* Work directly with founders, product, tech, content, and marketing to take designs live.
* Keep designs accessible and grounded in human\-factors principles.


****What You’ll Bring To The Role:****
* 3–5 years of experience in product/UI/UX design.
* A portfolio that can demonstrate your ability to work on modern digital interfaces.
* Craft beautiful experiences that visually present the user interface so information is easy to read, understand and find.
* Thorough understanding of the design process to perform research, build workflows and user journeys, execute design with high quality prototypes and test mock\-ups for feedback.
* Understanding and implementation of best practices including accessibility standards and human factors.
* A positive attitude and enthusiasm, willingness to iterate quickly and strong bias for action.
* Passion for design and simplifying complex problems, and a hunger to experiment with new and innovative solutions.
* A humble team player who is a great partner to work with for cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to learn from your mistakes and absorb feedback.
* Great communication skills, product thinking (why’s) and comfort with presenting and discussing designs.
* High proficiency in design tools like Figma and AI tooling to intelligently design creative experiences.
* Ability to learn and use analytics tools such as GA4, Mixpanel, and Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and make informed design decisions.


****Academic Qualifications****
* Bachelors or MA/MS degree (or higher) in Design (interaction, graphic or visual communication) or equivalent practical experience.


****What We Offer:****
* A founding\-designer seat on a 0\-to\-1 product: blank canvas, full ownership.
* Direct access to founders and daily collaboration with product and engineering.
* Autonomy to ideate, experiment, and execute, with regular reviews to accelerate your growth.
* A close\-knit, learning\-oriented design team and a hybrid working setup.
* Competitive salary.

title: UIUX Designer
company: Quantum Leap Learning Solutions Pvt Ltd
description:
About the Role:
 



  





 You have spent 3–6 years designing products that real users love, consumer apps,
 



 SaaS platforms, or both, and you know what it takes to get from a fuzzy problem to a
 



 polished, shipped experience.
 



 You will own design end\-to\-end across our mobile and web products, establish and
 



 evolve our design system, and set the bar for quality across the team. As we grow,
 



 you will have the opportunity to mentor junior designers and help build the design
 



 function from the ground up.
 



  





 Responsibilities:
 



  





 • Own end\-to\-end design for mobile (iOS \& Android) and web, from
 



 discovery and wireframes to final UI and handoff.
 



 • Translate user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant
 



 experiences.
 



 • Run user research, usability testing, and competitor analysis to inform
 



 design decisions.
 



 • Balance user needs with business constraints and technical feasibility.
 



 • Build, maintain, and evolve a scalable design system and component
 



 library across web and mobile.
 



 • Define design principles, patterns, and guidelines for consistent product
 



 experiences.
 



 • Partner with product, engineering, and stakeholders to align on goals and
 



 priorities.
 



 • Present design decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical
 



 audiences.
 



 • Mentor junior and mid\-level designers and help define design processes
 



 as the team scales.
 



  





 Requirements:
 



  





 • Proven experience designing B2C apps and SaaS products, from
 



 consumer\-grade usability to complex dashboards and multi\-user
 



 workflows.
 



 • Deep proficiency in Figma, components, auto\-layout, prototyping, and
 



 design tokens.
 



 • Strong understanding of mobile design patterns for iOS and Android.

title: Design Engineer
description:
**About Company**
 Dodo Payments is the Monetisation Engine for AI\-native products. We're a Merchant of Record \+ Billing \& Monetization platform that helps SaaS, AI, and digital businesses accept payments globally, automate billing (subscriptions, usage\-based, one\-time), and stay fully compliant with taxes and regulations in 220\+ countries.
   

  

 We absorb that complexity so our customers never have to think about it. Which means it lands in our product instead. Our users should never have to feel it.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a Design Engineer to help make Dodo Payments one of the best\-crafted products in fintech. You might be a designer who learned to code because handing off Figma was not enough, or an engineer who kept opening Figma because the interface was not good enough. Either way you care deeply about both.
   

  

 You will sit directly between design and engineering, across dashboard, checkout, billing, onboarding, analytics, and new products. You will explore ideas visually, prototype them quickly, and often build the final thing yourself. Sometimes the fastest way to answer a design question is Figma. Sometimes it is 100 lines of code.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and Build: Turn complicated payment concepts into surprisingly simple interfaces, and ship the production UI in React yourself.
* Prototyping: Explore and validate interactions quickly, before we commit engineering time to them.
* Interface Craft: Obsess over typography, hierarchy, density, motion, and state. Use motion and interaction where they genuinely improve understanding, and not where they do not.
* 0 to 1 Product: Design and build new product experiences from scratch, starting from ambiguous problems.
* Systems and Primitives: Create the components and patterns that make the rest of Dodo better, without disappearing into a design system that never ships product.
* Raising the Bar: Improve existing experiences instead of accepting "it works," and push back when something is not good enough.
* Collaboration: Work directly with engineers, product, and founders on product decisions.


 You will have a lot of room to define Dodo's visual and interaction language. We expect you to use it.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Experience: 2\+ years designing and building production web interfaces, in a role that spanned both.
* Figma: Excellent with Figma as a thinking and prototyping tool, not just a handoff surface.
* Code: Comfortable writing React and TypeScript, and shipping your own work to production.
* Visual Taste: Strong visual judgment, and the ability to explain why something works.
* Interaction and Motion: Care for how interfaces move and respond. Framer Motion, Rive, GSAP, Three.js or similar is useful, but a particular library is not the point. Being able to make the thing in your head real is.
* Speed: You prototype extremely quickly and are comfortable starting from an ambiguous problem.
* Judgment: You know when simplicity takes more work, not less.
* Team Spirit: Experience in startups or dynamic high\-growth environments is preferred.


**Why Join Us?**
* Impact: Be part of the founding team, and own how Dodo looks and feels. "Fintech has to look boring" is not an acceptable design constraint here.
* Ownership: You are not decorating finished requirements or producing mockups for someone else to interpret. You design it, you build it, you ship it.
* Growth Potential: Immense potential for personal and professional growth as the company expands.
* Equity: Competitive salary and equity package.
